+    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
+
+    for (int linear = tid; linear < R1_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
+        const int localX = linear % R1_TILE_X;
+        const int yz = linear / R1_TILE_X;
+        const int localY = yz % R1_TILE_Y;
+        const int localZ = yz / R1_TILE_Y;
+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originX) + localX - 1, nx);
+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + localY - 1, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + localZ - 1, nz);
+        cTile[linear] = input[globalZ * plane + globalY * nx + globalX];
     }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) return;
+
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
+    const int tz = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(tx, ty, tz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y);
+    const double center = cTile[centerIndex];
+    const double cxx = cTile[centerIndex + 1] + cTile[centerIndex - 1]
+                     - 2.0 * center;
+    const double cyy = cTile[centerIndex + R1_TILE_X]
+                     + cTile[centerIndex - R1_TILE_X] - 2.0 * center;
+    constexpr size_t r1Plane = R1_TILE_X * R1_TILE_Y;
+    const double czz = cTile[centerIndex + r1Plane]
+                     + cTile[centerIndex - r1Plane] - 2.0 * center;
+    const double bulk = center * center * center - center;
+    mu[z * plane + y * nx + x] = bulk - 0.5 * (cxx + cyy + czz);
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)
+void updateConcentrationKernel(double* __restrict__ output,
+                               const double* __restrict__ input,
+                               const double* __restrict__ mu,
+                               const size_t nx, const size_t ny,
+                               const size_t nz, const size_t plane) {
+    __shared__ double muTile[R1_TILE_SIZE];
+    const int tid = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x)
+                  + BLOCK_X * (static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y)
+                  + BLOCK_Y * static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z));
+    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
+    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
+    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
+
+    for (int linear = tid; linear < R1_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
+        const int localX = linear % R1_TILE_X;
+        const int yz = linear / R1_TILE_X;
+        const int localY = yz % R1_TILE_Y;
+        const int localZ = yz / R1_TILE_Y;
+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originX) + localX - 1, nx);
+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + localY - 1, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + localZ - 1, nz);
+        muTile[linear] = mu[globalZ * plane + globalY * nx + globalX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) return;
+
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
+    const int tz = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(tx, ty, tz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y);
+    const double center = muTile[centerIndex];
+    constexpr size_t r1Plane = R1_TILE_X * R1_TILE_Y;
+    const double laplacianMu =
+        (muTile[centerIndex + 1] + muTile[centerIndex - 1] - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[centerIndex + R1_TILE_X] + muTile[centerIndex - R1_TILE_X]
+         - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[centerIndex + r1Plane] + muTile[centerIndex - r1Plane]
+         - 2.0 * center);
+    const size_t globalIndex = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    output[globalIndex] = input[globalIndex] + 0.01 * laplacianMu;
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)
+void cahnHilliardStep(double* __restrict__ output,
+                      const double* __restrict__ input,
+                      const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+                      const size_t plane) {
+    __shared__ double shared[C_TILE_SIZE + MU_TILE_SIZE];
+    double* const cTile = shared;
+    double* const muTile = shared + C_TILE_SIZE;
+
+    const int tid = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x)
+                  + BLOCK_X * (static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y)
+                  + BLOCK_Y * static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z));
+    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
+    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
+    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
+
+    // Cooperatively stage the radius-two concentration tile.  Loading a
+    // clamped halo here gives the same zero-normal-gradient boundary rule as
+    // the original per-neighbor index clamping.
+    for (int linear = tid; linear < C_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
+        const int localX = linear % C_TILE_X;
+        const int yz = linear / C_TILE_X;
+        const int localY = yz % C_TILE_Y;
+        const int localZ = yz / C_TILE_Y;
+
+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originX) + localX - 2, nx);
+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + localY - 2, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + localZ - 2, nz);
+        cTile[linear] = input[globalZ * plane + globalY * nx + globalX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    // Form mu for the output tile and its one-cell halo.  The coordinate is
+    // clamped before locating its center in cTile; this detail is required at
+    // domain faces because Laplacian(mu) reuses mu at the boundary itself.
+    for (int linear = tid; linear < MU_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
+        const int muX = linear % MU_TILE_X;
+        const int yz = linear / MU_TILE_X;
+        const int muY = yz % MU_TILE_Y;
+        const int muZ = yz / MU_TILE_Y;
+
+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originX) + muX - 1, nx);
+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + muY - 1, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + muZ - 1, nz);
+
+        const int cX = static_cast<int>(globalX - originX) + 2;
+        const int cY = static_cast<int>(globalY - originY) + 2;
+        const int cZ = static_cast<int>(globalZ - originZ) + 2;
+        muTile[linear] = chemicalPotential(cTile, cX, cY, cZ);
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int muX = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;
+    const int muY = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
+    const int muZ = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t muCenter = tileIndex(muX, muY, muZ, MU_TILE_X, MU_TILE_Y);
+    constexpr size_t muPlane = MU_TILE_X * MU_TILE_Y;
+    const double center = muTile[muCenter];
+    const double laplacianMu =
+        (muTile[muCenter + 1] + muTile[muCenter - 1] - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[muCenter + MU_TILE_X] + muTile[muCenter - MU_TILE_X]
+         - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[muCenter + muPlane] + muTile[muCenter - muPlane]
+         - 2.0 * center);
+
+    const size_t globalIndex = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    output[globalIndex] = cTile[tileIndex(muX + 1, muY + 1, muZ + 1,
+                                          C_TILE_X, C_TILE_Y)]
+                        + 0.01 * laplacianMu;
 }

+__device__ __forceinline__ size_t clampCoordinate(const long long coordinate,
+                                                  const size_t extent) {
+    if (coordinate <= 0) {
+        return 0;
     }
+    const size_t value = static_cast<size_t>(coordinate);
+    return value < extent ? value : extent - 1;

+__device__ __forceinline__ double chemicalPotential(const double* __restrict__ c,
+                                                    const int x, const int y,
+                                                    const int z) {
+    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(x, y, z, C_TILE_X, C_TILE_Y);
+    const double center = c[centerIndex];
+    const double cxx = c[centerIndex + 1] + c[centerIndex - 1] - 2.0 * center;
+    const double cyy = c[centerIndex + C_TILE_X] + c[centerIndex - C_TILE_X]
+                     - 2.0 * center;
+    constexpr size_t cPlane = C_TILE_X * C_TILE_Y;
+    const double czz = c[centerIndex + cPlane] + c[centerIndex - cPlane]
+                     - 2.0 * center;
+
+    // With the benchmark's fixed interaction energies this is exactly the
+    // polynomial represented by the original bulk-energy expression.
+    const double bulk = center * center * center - center;
+    return bulk - 0.5 * (cxx + cyy + czz);
 }

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)
+void computeChemicalPotentialKernel(double* __restrict__ mu,
+                                    const double* __restrict__ input,
+                                    const size_t nx, const size_t ny,

+    const int tid = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x)

+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(

+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + localZ - 1, nz);
+        cTile[linear] = input[globalZ * plane + globalY * nx + globalX];
     }
+    __syncthreads();
+

+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) return;
+

+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
+    const int tz = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(tx, ty, tz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y);
+    const double center = cTile[centerIndex];
+    const double cxx = cTile[centerIndex + 1] + cTile[centerIndex - 1]
+                     - 2.0 * center;
+    const double cyy = cTile[centerIndex + R1_TILE_X]
+                     + cTile[centerIndex - R1_TILE_X] - 2.0 * center;
+    constexpr size_t r1Plane = R1_TILE_X * R1_TILE_Y;
+    const double czz = cTile[centerIndex + r1Plane]
+                     + cTile[centerIndex - r1Plane] - 2.0 * center;
+    const double bulk = center * center * center - center;
+    mu[z * plane + y * nx + x] = bulk - 0.5 * (cxx + cyy + czz);
+}

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)
+void updateConcentrationKernel(double* __restrict__ output,
+                               const double* __restrict__ input,
+                               const double* __restrict__ mu,
+                               const size_t nx, const size_t ny,
+                               const size_t nz, const size_t plane) {
+    __shared__ double muTile[R1_TILE_SIZE];
+    const int tid = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x)
+                  + BLOCK_X * (static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y)
+                  + BLOCK_Y * static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z));
+    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
+    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
+    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
+
+    for (int linear = tid; linear < R1_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
+        const int localX = linear % R1_TILE_X;
+        const int yz = linear / R1_TILE_X;
+        const int localY = yz % R1_TILE_Y;
+        const int localZ = yz / R1_TILE_Y;
+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originX) + localX - 1, nx);
+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + localY - 1, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + localZ - 1, nz);
+        muTile[linear] = mu[globalZ * plane + globalY * nx + globalX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) return;
+
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
+    const int tz = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(tx, ty, tz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y);
+    const double center = muTile[centerIndex];
+    constexpr size_t r1Plane = R1_TILE_X * R1_TILE_Y;
+    const double laplacianMu =
+        (muTile[centerIndex + 1] + muTile[centerIndex - 1] - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[centerIndex + R1_TILE_X] + muTile[centerIndex - R1_TILE_X]
+         - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[centerIndex + r1Plane] + muTile[centerIndex - r1Plane]
+         - 2.0 * center);
+    const size_t globalIndex = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    output[globalIndex] = input[globalIndex] + 0.01 * laplacianMu;
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)
+void cahnHilliardStep(double* __restrict__ output,
+                      const double* __restrict__ input,
+                      const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+                      const size_t plane) {
+    __shared__ double shared[C_TILE_SIZE + MU_TILE_SIZE];
+    double* const cTile = shared;
+    double* const muTile = shared + C_TILE_SIZE;
+
+    const int tid = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x)
+                  + BLOCK_X * (static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y)
+                  + BLOCK_Y * static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z));
+    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
+    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
+    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
+
+    // Cooperatively stage the radius-two concentration tile.  Loading a
+    // clamped halo here gives the same zero-normal-gradient boundary rule as
+    // the original per-neighbor index clamping.
+    for (int linear = tid; linear < C_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
+        const int localX = linear % C_TILE_X;
+        const int yz = linear / C_TILE_X;
+        const int localY = yz % C_TILE_Y;
+        const int localZ = yz / C_TILE_Y;
+
+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originX) + localX - 2, nx);
+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + localY - 2, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + localZ - 2, nz);
+        cTile[linear] = input[globalZ * plane + globalY * nx + globalX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    // Form mu for the output tile and its one-cell halo.  The coordinate is
+    // clamped before locating its center in cTile; this detail is required at
+    // domain faces because Laplacian(mu) reuses mu at the boundary itself.
+    for (int linear = tid; linear < MU_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
+        const int muX = linear % MU_TILE_X;
+        const int yz = linear / MU_TILE_X;
+        const int muY = yz % MU_TILE_Y;
+        const int muZ = yz / MU_TILE_Y;
+
+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originX) + muX - 1, nx);
+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + muY - 1, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + muZ - 1, nz);
+
+        const int cX = static_cast<int>(globalX - originX) + 2;
+        const int cY = static_cast<int>(globalY - originY) + 2;
+        const int cZ = static_cast<int>(globalZ - originZ) + 2;
+        muTile[linear] = chemicalPotential(cTile, cX, cY, cZ);
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int muX = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;
+    const int muY = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
+    const int muZ = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t muCenter = tileIndex(muX, muY, muZ, MU_TILE_X, MU_TILE_Y);
+    constexpr size_t muPlane = MU_TILE_X * MU_TILE_Y;
+    const double center = muTile[muCenter];
+    const double laplacianMu =
+        (muTile[muCenter + 1] + muTile[muCenter - 1] - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[muCenter + MU_TILE_X] + muTile[muCenter - MU_TILE_X]
+         - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[muCenter + muPlane] + muTile[muCenter - muPlane]
+         - 2.0 * center);
+
+    const size_t globalIndex = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    output[globalIndex] = cTile[tileIndex(muX + 1, muY + 1, muZ + 1,
+                                          C_TILE_X, C_TILE_Y)]
+                        + 0.01 * laplacianMu;
 }

+__device__ __forceinline__ size_t clampCoordinate(const long long coordinate,
+                                                  const size_t extent) {
+    if (coordinate <= 0) {
+        return 0;
     }
+    const size_t value = static_cast<size_t>(coordinate);
+    return value < extent ? value : extent - 1;

+__device__ __forceinline__ double chemicalPotential(const double* __restrict__ c,
+                                                    const int x, const int y,
+                                                    const int z) {
+    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(x, y, z, C_TILE_X, C_TILE_Y);
+    const double center = c[centerIndex];
+    const double cxx = c[centerIndex + 1] + c[centerIndex - 1] - 2.0 * center;
+    const double cyy = c[centerIndex + C_TILE_X] + c[centerIndex - C_TILE_X]
+                     - 2.0 * center;
+    constexpr size_t cPlane = C_TILE_X * C_TILE_Y;
+    const double czz = c[centerIndex + cPlane] + c[centerIndex - cPlane]
+                     - 2.0 * center;
+

+    // polynomial represented by the original bulk-energy expression.
+    const double bulk = center * center * center - center;
+    return bulk - 0.5 * (cxx + cyy + czz);

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)
+void computeChemicalPotentialKernel(double* __restrict__ mu,
+                                    const double* __restrict__ input,
+                                    const size_t nx, const size_t ny,
+                                    const size_t nz, const size_t plane) {

+                  + BLOCK_Y * static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z));

+

+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;

+

+    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(tx, ty, tz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y);

+    const double czz = cTile[centerIndex + r1Plane]
+                     + cTile[centerIndex - r1Plane] - 2.0 * center;
+    const double bulk = center * center * center - center;
+    mu[z * plane + y * nx + x] = bulk - 0.5 * (cxx + cyy + czz);
+}

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)
+void updateConcentrationKernel(double* __restrict__ output,
+                               const double* __restrict__ input,
+                               const double* __restrict__ mu,
+                               const size_t nx, const size_t ny,
+                               const size_t nz, const size_t plane) {
+    __shared__ double muTile[R1_TILE_SIZE];
+    const int tid = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x)
+                  + BLOCK_X * (static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y)
+                  + BLOCK_Y * static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z));
+    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
+    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
+    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
+
+    for (int linear = tid; linear < R1_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
+        const int localX = linear % R1_TILE_X;
+        const int yz = linear / R1_TILE_X;
+        const int localY = yz % R1_TILE_Y;
+        const int localZ = yz / R1_TILE_Y;
+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originX) + localX - 1, nx);
+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + localY - 1, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + localZ - 1, nz);
+        muTile[linear] = mu[globalZ * plane + globalY * nx + globalX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) return;
+
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
+    const int tz = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(tx, ty, tz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y);
+    const double center = muTile[centerIndex];
+    constexpr size_t r1Plane = R1_TILE_X * R1_TILE_Y;
+    const double laplacianMu =
+        (muTile[centerIndex + 1] + muTile[centerIndex - 1] - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[centerIndex + R1_TILE_X] + muTile[centerIndex - R1_TILE_X]
+         - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[centerIndex + r1Plane] + muTile[centerIndex - r1Plane]
+         - 2.0 * center);
+    const size_t globalIndex = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    output[globalIndex] = input[globalIndex] + 0.01 * laplacianMu;
+}

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)
+void cahnHilliardStep(double* __restrict__ output,
+                      const double* __restrict__ input,
+                      const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+                      const size_t plane) {
+    __shared__ double shared[C_TILE_SIZE + MU_TILE_SIZE];
+    double* const cTile = shared;
+    double* const muTile = shared + C_TILE_SIZE;
+
+    const int tid = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x)
+                  + BLOCK_X * (static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y)
+                  + BLOCK_Y * static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z));
+    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
+    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
+    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
+
+    // Cooperatively stage the radius-two concentration tile.  Loading a
+    // clamped halo here gives the same zero-normal-gradient boundary rule as
+    // the original per-neighbor index clamping.
+    for (int linear = tid; linear < C_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
+        const int localX = linear % C_TILE_X;
+        const int yz = linear / C_TILE_X;
+        const int localY = yz % C_TILE_Y;
+        const int localZ = yz / C_TILE_Y;
+
+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originX) + localX - 2, nx);
+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + localY - 2, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + localZ - 2, nz);
+        cTile[linear] = input[globalZ * plane + globalY * nx + globalX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    // Form mu for the output tile and its one-cell halo.  The coordinate is
+    // clamped before locating its center in cTile; this detail is required at
+    // domain faces because Laplacian(mu) reuses mu at the boundary itself.
+    for (int linear = tid; linear < MU_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
+        const int muX = linear % MU_TILE_X;
+        const int yz = linear / MU_TILE_X;
+        const int muY = yz % MU_TILE_Y;
+        const int muZ = yz / MU_TILE_Y;
+
+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originX) + muX - 1, nx);
+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + muY - 1, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + muZ - 1, nz);
+
+        const int cX = static_cast<int>(globalX - originX) + 2;
+        const int cY = static_cast<int>(globalY - originY) + 2;
+        const int cZ = static_cast<int>(globalZ - originZ) + 2;
+        muTile[linear] = chemicalPotential(cTile, cX, cY, cZ);
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int muX = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;
+    const int muY = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
+    const int muZ = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t muCenter = tileIndex(muX, muY, muZ, MU_TILE_X, MU_TILE_Y);
+    constexpr size_t muPlane = MU_TILE_X * MU_TILE_Y;
+    const double center = muTile[muCenter];
+    const double laplacianMu =
+        (muTile[muCenter + 1] + muTile[muCenter - 1] - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[muCenter + MU_TILE_X] + muTile[muCenter - MU_TILE_X]
+         - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[muCenter + muPlane] + muTile[muCenter - muPlane]
+         - 2.0 * center);
+
+    const size_t globalIndex = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    output[globalIndex] = cTile[tileIndex(muX + 1, muY + 1, muZ + 1,
+                                          C_TILE_X, C_TILE_Y)]
+                        + 0.01 * laplacianMu;
 }

+    constexpr size_t cPlane = C_TILE_X * C_TILE_Y;
+    const double czz = c[centerIndex + cPlane] + c[centerIndex - cPlane]
+                     - 2.0 * center;

+    // With the benchmark's fixed interaction energies this is exactly the
+    // polynomial represented by the original bulk-energy expression.
+    const double bulk = center * center * center - center;
+    return bulk - 0.5 * (cxx + cyy + czz);
 }

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)
+void computeChemicalPotentialKernel(double* __restrict__ mu,
+                                    const double* __restrict__ input,

+                                    const size_t nz, const size_t plane) {

+        cTile[linear] = input[globalZ * plane + globalY * nx + globalX];
     }

+
+    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) return;
+
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;

+    const int tz = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(tx, ty, tz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y);
+    const double center = cTile[centerIndex];
+    const double cxx = cTile[centerIndex + 1] + cTile[centerIndex - 1]
+                     - 2.0 * center;
+    const double cyy = cTile[centerIndex + R1_TILE_X]
+                     + cTile[centerIndex - R1_TILE_X] - 2.0 * center;
+    constexpr size_t r1Plane = R1_TILE_X * R1_TILE_Y;
+    const double czz = cTile[centerIndex + r1Plane]
+                     + cTile[centerIndex - r1Plane] - 2.0 * center;
+    const double bulk = center * center * center - center;
+    mu[z * plane + y * nx + x] = bulk - 0.5 * (cxx + cyy + czz);
+}

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)
+void updateConcentrationKernel(double* __restrict__ output,
+                               const double* __restrict__ input,
+                               const double* __restrict__ mu,
+                               const size_t nx, const size_t ny,
+                               const size_t nz, const size_t plane) {
+    __shared__ double muTile[R1_TILE_SIZE];
+    const int tid = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x)
+                  + BLOCK_X * (static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y)
+                  + BLOCK_Y * static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z));
+    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
+    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
+    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
+
+    for (int linear = tid; linear < R1_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
+        const int localX = linear % R1_TILE_X;
+        const int yz = linear / R1_TILE_X;
+        const int localY = yz % R1_TILE_Y;
+        const int localZ = yz / R1_TILE_Y;
+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originX) + localX - 1, nx);
+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + localY - 1, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + localZ - 1, nz);
+        muTile[linear] = mu[globalZ * plane + globalY * nx + globalX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) return;
+
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
+    const int tz = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(tx, ty, tz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y);
+    const double center = muTile[centerIndex];
+    constexpr size_t r1Plane = R1_TILE_X * R1_TILE_Y;
+    const double laplacianMu =
+        (muTile[centerIndex + 1] + muTile[centerIndex - 1] - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[centerIndex + R1_TILE_X] + muTile[centerIndex - R1_TILE_X]
+         - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[centerIndex + r1Plane] + muTile[centerIndex - r1Plane]
+         - 2.0 * center);
+    const size_t globalIndex = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    output[globalIndex] = input[globalIndex] + 0.01 * laplacianMu;
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)
+void cahnHilliardStep(double* __restrict__ output,
+                      const double* __restrict__ input,
+                      const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+                      const size_t plane) {
+    __shared__ double shared[C_TILE_SIZE + MU_TILE_SIZE];
+    double* const cTile = shared;
+    double* const muTile = shared + C_TILE_SIZE;
+
+    const int tid = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x)
+                  + BLOCK_X * (static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y)
+                  + BLOCK_Y * static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z));
+    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
+    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
+    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
+
+    // Cooperatively stage the radius-two concentration tile.  Loading a
+    // clamped halo here gives the same zero-normal-gradient boundary rule as
+    // the original per-neighbor index clamping.
+    for (int linear = tid; linear < C_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
+        const int localX = linear % C_TILE_X;
+        const int yz = linear / C_TILE_X;
+        const int localY = yz % C_TILE_Y;
+        const int localZ = yz / C_TILE_Y;
+
+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originX) + localX - 2, nx);
+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + localY - 2, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + localZ - 2, nz);
+        cTile[linear] = input[globalZ * plane + globalY * nx + globalX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    // Form mu for the output tile and its one-cell halo.  The coordinate is
+    // clamped before locating its center in cTile; this detail is required at
+    // domain faces because Laplacian(mu) reuses mu at the boundary itself.
+    for (int linear = tid; linear < MU_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
+        const int muX = linear % MU_TILE_X;
+        const int yz = linear / MU_TILE_X;
+        const int muY = yz % MU_TILE_Y;
+        const int muZ = yz / MU_TILE_Y;
+
+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originX) + muX - 1, nx);
+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + muY - 1, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + muZ - 1, nz);
+
+        const int cX = static_cast<int>(globalX - originX) + 2;
+        const int cY = static_cast<int>(globalY - originY) + 2;
+        const int cZ = static_cast<int>(globalZ - originZ) + 2;
+        muTile[linear] = chemicalPotential(cTile, cX, cY, cZ);
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int muX = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;
+    const int muY = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
+    const int muZ = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t muCenter = tileIndex(muX, muY, muZ, MU_TILE_X, MU_TILE_Y);
+    constexpr size_t muPlane = MU_TILE_X * MU_TILE_Y;
+    const double center = muTile[muCenter];
+    const double laplacianMu =
+        (muTile[muCenter + 1] + muTile[muCenter - 1] - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[muCenter + MU_TILE_X] + muTile[muCenter - MU_TILE_X]
+         - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[muCenter + muPlane] + muTile[muCenter - muPlane]
+         - 2.0 * center);
+
+    const size_t globalIndex = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    output[globalIndex] = cTile[tileIndex(muX + 1, muY + 1, muZ + 1,
+                                          C_TILE_X, C_TILE_Y)]
+                        + 0.01 * laplacianMu;
 }

+__device__ __forceinline__ size_t clampCoordinate(const long long coordinate,
+                                                  const size_t extent) {
+    if (coordinate <= 0) {

     }

+__device__ __forceinline__ double chemicalPotential(const double* __restrict__ c,
+                                                    const int x, const int y,
+                                                    const int z) {
+    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(x, y, z, C_TILE_X, C_TILE_Y);
+    const double center = c[centerIndex];
+    const double cxx = c[centerIndex + 1] + c[centerIndex - 1] - 2.0 * center;
+    const double cyy = c[centerIndex + C_TILE_X] + c[centerIndex - C_TILE_X]
+                     - 2.0 * center;
+    constexpr size_t cPlane = C_TILE_X * C_TILE_Y;
+    const double czz = c[centerIndex + cPlane] + c[centerIndex - cPlane]
+                     - 2.0 * center;
+
+    // With the benchmark's fixed interaction energies this is exactly the
+    // polynomial represented by the original bulk-energy expression.
+    const double bulk = center * center * center - center;
+    return bulk - 0.5 * (cxx + cyy + czz);

+}

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)
+void updateConcentrationKernel(double* __restrict__ output,
+                               const double* __restrict__ input,
+                               const double* __restrict__ mu,
+                               const size_t nx, const size_t ny,
+                               const size_t nz, const size_t plane) {

+    const int tid = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x)

+

+        const int yz = linear / R1_TILE_X;
+        const int localY = yz % R1_TILE_Y;

+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + localY - 1, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + localZ - 1, nz);
+        muTile[linear] = mu[globalZ * plane + globalY * nx + globalX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) return;
+
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
+    const int tz = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(tx, ty, tz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y);
+    const double center = muTile[centerIndex];
+    constexpr size_t r1Plane = R1_TILE_X * R1_TILE_Y;
+    const double laplacianMu =
+        (muTile[centerIndex + 1] + muTile[centerIndex - 1] - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[centerIndex + R1_TILE_X] + muTile[centerIndex - R1_TILE_X]
+         - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[centerIndex + r1Plane] + muTile[centerIndex - r1Plane]
+         - 2.0 * center);
+    const size_t globalIndex = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    output[globalIndex] = input[globalIndex] + 0.01 * laplacianMu;
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)
+void cahnHilliardStep(double* __restrict__ output,
+                      const double* __restrict__ input,
+                      const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+                      const size_t plane) {
+    __shared__ double shared[C_TILE_SIZE + MU_TILE_SIZE];
+    double* const cTile = shared;
+    double* const muTile = shared + C_TILE_SIZE;
+
+    const int tid = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x)
+                  + BLOCK_X * (static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y)
+                  + BLOCK_Y * static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z));
+    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
+    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
+    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
+
+    // Cooperatively stage the radius-two concentration tile.  Loading a
+    // clamped halo here gives the same zero-normal-gradient boundary rule as
+    // the original per-neighbor index clamping.
+    for (int linear = tid; linear < C_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
+        const int localX = linear % C_TILE_X;
+        const int yz = linear / C_TILE_X;
+        const int localY = yz % C_TILE_Y;
+        const int localZ = yz / C_TILE_Y;
+
+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originX) + localX - 2, nx);
+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + localY - 2, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + localZ - 2, nz);
+        cTile[linear] = input[globalZ * plane + globalY * nx + globalX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    // Form mu for the output tile and its one-cell halo.  The coordinate is
+    // clamped before locating its center in cTile; this detail is required at
+    // domain faces because Laplacian(mu) reuses mu at the boundary itself.
+    for (int linear = tid; linear < MU_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
+        const int muX = linear % MU_TILE_X;
+        const int yz = linear / MU_TILE_X;
+        const int muY = yz % MU_TILE_Y;
+        const int muZ = yz / MU_TILE_Y;
+
+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originX) + muX - 1, nx);
+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + muY - 1, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + muZ - 1, nz);
+
+        const int cX = static_cast<int>(globalX - originX) + 2;
+        const int cY = static_cast<int>(globalY - originY) + 2;
+        const int cZ = static_cast<int>(globalZ - originZ) + 2;
+        muTile[linear] = chemicalPotential(cTile, cX, cY, cZ);
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int muX = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;
+    const int muY = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
+    const int muZ = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t muCenter = tileIndex(muX, muY, muZ, MU_TILE_X, MU_TILE_Y);
+    constexpr size_t muPlane = MU_TILE_X * MU_TILE_Y;
+    const double center = muTile[muCenter];
+    const double laplacianMu =
+        (muTile[muCenter + 1] + muTile[muCenter - 1] - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[muCenter + MU_TILE_X] + muTile[muCenter - MU_TILE_X]
+         - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[muCenter + muPlane] + muTile[muCenter - muPlane]
+         - 2.0 * center);
+
+    const size_t globalIndex = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    output[globalIndex] = cTile[tileIndex(muX + 1, muY + 1, muZ + 1,
+                                          C_TILE_X, C_TILE_Y)]
+                        + 0.01 * laplacianMu;
 }

+__device__ __forceinline__ size_t clampCoordinate(const long long coordinate,
+                                                  const size_t extent) {
+    if (coordinate <= 0) {
+        return 0;
     }
+    const size_t value = static_cast<size_t>(coordinate);
+    return value < extent ? value : extent - 1;

+__device__ __forceinline__ double chemicalPotential(const double* __restrict__ c,
+                                                    const int x, const int y,
+                                                    const int z) {
+    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(x, y, z, C_TILE_X, C_TILE_Y);
+    const double center = c[centerIndex];
+    const double cxx = c[centerIndex + 1] + c[centerIndex - 1] - 2.0 * center;
+    const double cyy = c[centerIndex + C_TILE_X] + c[centerIndex - C_TILE_X]
+                     - 2.0 * center;
+    constexpr size_t cPlane = C_TILE_X * C_TILE_Y;
+    const double czz = c[centerIndex + cPlane] + c[centerIndex - cPlane]
+                     - 2.0 * center;
+
+    // With the benchmark's fixed interaction energies this is exactly the
+    // polynomial represented by the original bulk-energy expression.
+    const double bulk = center * center * center - center;
+    return bulk - 0.5 * (cxx + cyy + czz);

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)
+void computeChemicalPotentialKernel(double* __restrict__ mu,

+    const int tid = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x)

+    const double center = muTile[centerIndex];
+    constexpr size_t r1Plane = R1_TILE_X * R1_TILE_Y;

+         - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[centerIndex + r1Plane] + muTile[centerIndex - r1Plane]
+         - 2.0 * center);
+    const size_t globalIndex = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    output[globalIndex] = input[globalIndex] + 0.01 * laplacianMu;
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)
+void cahnHilliardStep(double* __restrict__ output,
+                      const double* __restrict__ input,
+                      const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+                      const size_t plane) {
+    __shared__ double shared[C_TILE_SIZE + MU_TILE_SIZE];
+    double* const cTile = shared;
+    double* const muTile = shared + C_TILE_SIZE;
+
+    const int tid = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x)
+                  + BLOCK_X * (static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y)
+                  + BLOCK_Y * static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z));
+    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
+    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
+    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
+
+    // Cooperatively stage the radius-two concentration tile.  Loading a
+    // clamped halo here gives the same zero-normal-gradient boundary rule as
+    // the original per-neighbor index clamping.
+    for (int linear = tid; linear < C_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
+        const int localX = linear % C_TILE_X;
+        const int yz = linear / C_TILE_X;
+        const int localY = yz % C_TILE_Y;
+        const int localZ = yz / C_TILE_Y;
+
+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originX) + localX - 2, nx);
+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + localY - 2, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + localZ - 2, nz);
+        cTile[linear] = input[globalZ * plane + globalY * nx + globalX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    // Form mu for the output tile and its one-cell halo.  The coordinate is
+    // clamped before locating its center in cTile; this detail is required at
+    // domain faces because Laplacian(mu) reuses mu at the boundary itself.
+    for (int linear = tid; linear < MU_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
+        const int muX = linear % MU_TILE_X;
+        const int yz = linear / MU_TILE_X;
+        const int muY = yz % MU_TILE_Y;
+        const int muZ = yz / MU_TILE_Y;
+
+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originX) + muX - 1, nx);
+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + muY - 1, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + muZ - 1, nz);
+
+        const int cX = static_cast<int>(globalX - originX) + 2;
+        const int cY = static_cast<int>(globalY - originY) + 2;
+        const int cZ = static_cast<int>(globalZ - originZ) + 2;
+        muTile[linear] = chemicalPotential(cTile, cX, cY, cZ);
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int muX = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;
+    const int muY = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
+    const int muZ = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t muCenter = tileIndex(muX, muY, muZ, MU_TILE_X, MU_TILE_Y);
+    constexpr size_t muPlane = MU_TILE_X * MU_TILE_Y;
+    const double center = muTile[muCenter];
+    const double laplacianMu =
+        (muTile[muCenter + 1] + muTile[muCenter - 1] - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[muCenter + MU_TILE_X] + muTile[muCenter - MU_TILE_X]
+         - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[muCenter + muPlane] + muTile[muCenter - muPlane]
+         - 2.0 * center);
+
+    const size_t globalIndex = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    output[globalIndex] = cTile[tileIndex(muX + 1, muY + 1, muZ + 1,
+                                          C_TILE_X, C_TILE_Y)]
+                        + 0.01 * laplacianMu;
 }

+__device__ __forceinline__ size_t clampCoordinate(const long long coordinate,
+                                                  const size_t extent) {
+    if (coordinate <= 0) {
+        return 0;
     }
+    const size_t value = static_cast<size_t>(coordinate);
+    return value < extent ? value : extent - 1;

+__device__ __forceinline__ double chemicalPotential(const double* __restrict__ c,
+                                                    const int x, const int y,
+                                                    const int z) {
+    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(x, y, z, C_TILE_X, C_TILE_Y);
+    const double center = c[centerIndex];
+    const double cxx = c[centerIndex + 1] + c[centerIndex - 1] - 2.0 * center;
+    const double cyy = c[centerIndex + C_TILE_X] + c[centerIndex - C_TILE_X]
+                     - 2.0 * center;
+    constexpr size_t cPlane = C_TILE_X * C_TILE_Y;
+    const double czz = c[centerIndex + cPlane] + c[centerIndex - cPlane]
+                     - 2.0 * center;
+
+    // With the benchmark's fixed interaction energies this is exactly the
+    // polynomial represented by the original bulk-energy expression.
+    const double bulk = center * center * center - center;
+    return bulk - 0.5 * (cxx + cyy + czz);
 }

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)
+void computeChemicalPotentialKernel(double* __restrict__ mu,
+                                    const double* __restrict__ input,

+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + localZ - 1, nz);
+        cTile[linear] = input[globalZ * plane + globalY * nx + globalX];
     }

+

+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) return;
+
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
+    const int tz = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(tx, ty, tz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y);
+    const double center = cTile[centerIndex];
+    const double cxx = cTile[centerIndex + 1] + cTile[centerIndex - 1]
+                     - 2.0 * center;
+    const double cyy = cTile[centerIndex + R1_TILE_X]
+                     + cTile[centerIndex - R1_TILE_X] - 2.0 * center;
+    constexpr size_t r1Plane = R1_TILE_X * R1_TILE_Y;
+    const double czz = cTile[centerIndex + r1Plane]
+                     + cTile[centerIndex - r1Plane] - 2.0 * center;
+    const double bulk = center * center * center - center;
+    mu[z * plane + y * nx + x] = bulk - 0.5 * (cxx + cyy + czz);
+}

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)
+void updateConcentrationKernel(double* __restrict__ output,
+                               const double* __restrict__ input,
+                               const double* __restrict__ mu,
+                               const size_t nx, const size_t ny,
+                               const size_t nz, const size_t plane) {
+    __shared__ double muTile[R1_TILE_SIZE];
+    const int tid = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x)
+                  + BLOCK_X * (static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y)
+                  + BLOCK_Y * static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z));
+    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
+    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
+    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
+

+        const int yz = linear / R1_TILE_X;
+        const int localY = yz % R1_TILE_Y;
+        const int localZ = yz / R1_TILE_Y;
+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(

+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + localY - 1, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + localZ - 1, nz);
+        muTile[linear] = mu[globalZ * plane + globalY * nx + globalX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) return;
+
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
+    const int tz = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(tx, ty, tz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y);
+    const double center = muTile[centerIndex];
+    constexpr size_t r1Plane = R1_TILE_X * R1_TILE_Y;
+    const double laplacianMu =
+        (muTile[centerIndex + 1] + muTile[centerIndex - 1] - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[centerIndex + R1_TILE_X] + muTile[centerIndex - R1_TILE_X]
+         - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[centerIndex + r1Plane] + muTile[centerIndex - r1Plane]
+         - 2.0 * center);
+    const size_t globalIndex = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    output[globalIndex] = input[globalIndex] + 0.01 * laplacianMu;
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)
+void cahnHilliardStep(double* __restrict__ output,
+                      const double* __restrict__ input,
+                      const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+                      const size_t plane) {
+    __shared__ double shared[C_TILE_SIZE + MU_TILE_SIZE];
+    double* const cTile = shared;
+    double* const muTile = shared + C_TILE_SIZE;
+
+    const int tid = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x)
+                  + BLOCK_X * (static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y)
+                  + BLOCK_Y * static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z));
+    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
+    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
+    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
+
+    // Cooperatively stage the radius-two concentration tile.  Loading a
+    // clamped halo here gives the same zero-normal-gradient boundary rule as
+    // the original per-neighbor index clamping.
+    for (int linear = tid; linear < C_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
+        const int localX = linear % C_TILE_X;
+        const int yz = linear / C_TILE_X;
+        const int localY = yz % C_TILE_Y;
+        const int localZ = yz / C_TILE_Y;
+
+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originX) + localX - 2, nx);
+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + localY - 2, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + localZ - 2, nz);
+        cTile[linear] = input[globalZ * plane + globalY * nx + globalX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    // Form mu for the output tile and its one-cell halo.  The coordinate is
+    // clamped before locating its center in cTile; this detail is required at
+    // domain faces because Laplacian(mu) reuses mu at the boundary itself.
+    for (int linear = tid; linear < MU_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
+        const int muX = linear % MU_TILE_X;
+        const int yz = linear / MU_TILE_X;
+        const int muY = yz % MU_TILE_Y;
+        const int muZ = yz / MU_TILE_Y;
+
+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originX) + muX - 1, nx);
+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + muY - 1, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + muZ - 1, nz);
+
+        const int cX = static_cast<int>(globalX - originX) + 2;
+        const int cY = static_cast<int>(globalY - originY) + 2;
+        const int cZ = static_cast<int>(globalZ - originZ) + 2;
+        muTile[linear] = chemicalPotential(cTile, cX, cY, cZ);
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int muX = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;
+    const int muY = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
+    const int muZ = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t muCenter = tileIndex(muX, muY, muZ, MU_TILE_X, MU_TILE_Y);
+    constexpr size_t muPlane = MU_TILE_X * MU_TILE_Y;
+    const double center = muTile[muCenter];
+    const double laplacianMu =
+        (muTile[muCenter + 1] + muTile[muCenter - 1] - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[muCenter + MU_TILE_X] + muTile[muCenter - MU_TILE_X]
+         - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[muCenter + muPlane] + muTile[muCenter - muPlane]
+         - 2.0 * center);
+
+    const size_t globalIndex = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    output[globalIndex] = cTile[tileIndex(muX + 1, muY + 1, muZ + 1,
+                                          C_TILE_X, C_TILE_Y)]
+                        + 0.01 * laplacianMu;
 }

+__device__ __forceinline__ double chemicalPotential(const double* __restrict__ c,
+                                                    const int x, const int y,
+                                                    const int z) {
+    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(x, y, z, C_TILE_X, C_TILE_Y);
+    const double center = c[centerIndex];
+    const double cxx = c[centerIndex + 1] + c[centerIndex - 1] - 2.0 * center;
+    const double cyy = c[centerIndex + C_TILE_X] + c[centerIndex - C_TILE_X]
+                     - 2.0 * center;

+    // polynomial represented by the original bulk-energy expression.

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)
+void cahnHilliardStep(double* __restrict__ output,
+                      const double* __restrict__ input,
+                      const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+                      const size_t plane) {
+    __shared__ double shared[C_TILE_SIZE + MU_TILE_SIZE];
+    double* const cTile = shared;
+    double* const muTile = shared + C_TILE_SIZE;
+
+    const int tid = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x)
+                  + BLOCK_X * (static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y)
+                  + BLOCK_Y * static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z));
+    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
+    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
+    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
+
+    // Cooperatively stage the radius-two concentration tile.  Loading a
+    // clamped halo here gives the same zero-normal-gradient boundary rule as
+    // the original per-neighbor index clamping.
+    for (int linear = tid; linear < C_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
+        const int localX = linear % C_TILE_X;
+        const int yz = linear / C_TILE_X;
+        const int localY = yz % C_TILE_Y;
+        const int localZ = yz / C_TILE_Y;
+
+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originX) + localX - 2, nx);
+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + localY - 2, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + localZ - 2, nz);
+        cTile[linear] = input[globalZ * plane + globalY * nx + globalX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    // Form mu for the output tile and its one-cell halo.  The coordinate is
+    // clamped before locating its center in cTile; this detail is required at
+    // domain faces because Laplacian(mu) reuses mu at the boundary itself.
+    for (int linear = tid; linear < MU_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
+        const int muX = linear % MU_TILE_X;
+        const int yz = linear / MU_TILE_X;
+        const int muY = yz % MU_TILE_Y;
+        const int muZ = yz / MU_TILE_Y;
+
+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originX) + muX - 1, nx);
+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + muY - 1, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + muZ - 1, nz);
+
+        const int cX = static_cast<int>(globalX - originX) + 2;
+        const int cY = static_cast<int>(globalY - originY) + 2;
+        const int cZ = static_cast<int>(globalZ - originZ) + 2;
+        muTile[linear] = chemicalPotential(cTile, cX, cY, cZ);
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int muX = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;
+    const int muY = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
+    const int muZ = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t muCenter = tileIndex(muX, muY, muZ, MU_TILE_X, MU_TILE_Y);
+    constexpr size_t muPlane = MU_TILE_X * MU_TILE_Y;
+    const double center = muTile[muCenter];
+    const double laplacianMu =
+        (muTile[muCenter + 1] + muTile[muCenter - 1] - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[muCenter + MU_TILE_X] + muTile[muCenter - MU_TILE_X]
+         - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[muCenter + muPlane] + muTile[muCenter - muPlane]
+         - 2.0 * center);
+
+    const size_t globalIndex = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    output[globalIndex] = cTile[tileIndex(muX + 1, muY + 1, muZ + 1,
+                                          C_TILE_X, C_TILE_Y)]
+                        + 0.01 * laplacianMu;
 }

+__device__ __forceinline__ size_t clampCoordinate(const long long coordinate,

+    if (coordinate <= 0) {

+__device__ __forceinline__ double chemicalPotential(const double* __restrict__ c,
+                                                    const int x, const int y,
+                                                    const int z) {
+    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(x, y, z, C_TILE_X, C_TILE_Y);
+    const double center = c[centerIndex];
+    const double cxx = c[centerIndex + 1] + c[centerIndex - 1] - 2.0 * center;
+    const double cyy = c[centerIndex + C_TILE_X] + c[centerIndex - C_TILE_X]
+                     - 2.0 * center;
+    constexpr size_t cPlane = C_TILE_X * C_TILE_Y;
+    const double czz = c[centerIndex + cPlane] + c[centerIndex - cPlane]
+                     - 2.0 * center;
+
+    // With the benchmark's fixed interaction energies this is exactly the
+    // polynomial represented by the original bulk-energy expression.
+    const double bulk = center * center * center - center;
+    return bulk - 0.5 * (cxx + cyy + czz);

+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
+    const int tz = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(tx, ty, tz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y);
+    const double center = cTile[centerIndex];
+    const double cxx = cTile[centerIndex + 1] + cTile[centerIndex - 1]
+                     - 2.0 * center;
+    const double cyy = cTile[centerIndex + R1_TILE_X]
+                     + cTile[centerIndex - R1_TILE_X] - 2.0 * center;
+    constexpr size_t r1Plane = R1_TILE_X * R1_TILE_Y;
+    const double czz = cTile[centerIndex + r1Plane]
+                     + cTile[centerIndex - r1Plane] - 2.0 * center;
+    const double bulk = center * center * center - center;
+    mu[z * plane + y * nx + x] = bulk - 0.5 * (cxx + cyy + czz);
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS, 6)
+void updateConcentrationKernel(double* __restrict__ output,
+                               const double* __restrict__ input,
+                               const double* __restrict__ mu,
+                               const size_t nx, const size_t ny,
+                               const size_t nz, const size_t plane) {
+    __shared__ double muTile[R1_TILE_SIZE];
+    const int tid = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x)
+                  + BLOCK_X * (static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y)
+                  + BLOCK_Y * static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z));
+    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
+    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
+    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
+
+    for (int linear = tid; linear < R1_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
+        const int localX = linear % R1_TILE_X;
+        const int yz = linear / R1_TILE_X;
+        const int localY = yz % R1_TILE_Y;
+        const int localZ = yz / R1_TILE_Y;
+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originX) + localX - 1, nx);
+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + localY - 1, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + localZ - 1, nz);
+        muTile[linear] = mu[globalZ * plane + globalY * nx + globalX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) return;
+
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
+    const int tz = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(tx, ty, tz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y);
+    const double center = muTile[centerIndex];
+    constexpr size_t r1Plane = R1_TILE_X * R1_TILE_Y;
+    const double laplacianMu =
+        (muTile[centerIndex + 1] + muTile[centerIndex - 1] - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[centerIndex + R1_TILE_X] + muTile[centerIndex - R1_TILE_X]
+         - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[centerIndex + r1Plane] + muTile[centerIndex - r1Plane]
+         - 2.0 * center);
+    const size_t globalIndex = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    output[globalIndex] = input[globalIndex] + 0.01 * laplacianMu;
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)
+void cahnHilliardStep(double* __restrict__ output,
+                      const double* __restrict__ input,
+                      const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+                      const size_t plane) {
+    __shared__ double shared[C_TILE_SIZE + MU_TILE_SIZE];
+    double* const cTile = shared;
+    double* const muTile = shared + C_TILE_SIZE;
+
+    const int tid = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x)
+                  + BLOCK_X * (static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y)
+                  + BLOCK_Y * static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z));
+    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
+    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
+    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
+
+    // Cooperatively stage the radius-two concentration tile.  Loading a
+    // clamped halo here gives the same zero-normal-gradient boundary rule as
+    // the original per-neighbor index clamping.
+    for (int linear = tid; linear < C_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
+        const int localX = linear % C_TILE_X;
+        const int yz = linear / C_TILE_X;
+        const int localY = yz % C_TILE_Y;
+        const int localZ = yz / C_TILE_Y;
+
+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originX) + localX - 2, nx);
+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + localY - 2, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + localZ - 2, nz);
+        cTile[linear] = input[globalZ * plane + globalY * nx + globalX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    // Form mu for the output tile and its one-cell halo.  The coordinate is
+    // clamped before locating its center in cTile; this detail is required at
+    // domain faces because Laplacian(mu) reuses mu at the boundary itself.
+    for (int linear = tid; linear < MU_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
+        const int muX = linear % MU_TILE_X;
+        const int yz = linear / MU_TILE_X;
+        const int muY = yz % MU_TILE_Y;
+        const int muZ = yz / MU_TILE_Y;
+
+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originX) + muX - 1, nx);
+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + muY - 1, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + muZ - 1, nz);
+
+        const int cX = static_cast<int>(globalX - originX) + 2;
+        const int cY = static_cast<int>(globalY - originY) + 2;
+        const int cZ = static_cast<int>(globalZ - originZ) + 2;
+        muTile[linear] = chemicalPotential(cTile, cX, cY, cZ);
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int muX = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;
+    const int muY = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
+    const int muZ = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t muCenter = tileIndex(muX, muY, muZ, MU_TILE_X, MU_TILE_Y);
+    constexpr size_t muPlane = MU_TILE_X * MU_TILE_Y;
+    const double center = muTile[muCenter];
+    const double laplacianMu =
+        (muTile[muCenter + 1] + muTile[muCenter - 1] - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[muCenter + MU_TILE_X] + muTile[muCenter - MU_TILE_X]
+         - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[muCenter + muPlane] + muTile[muCenter - muPlane]
+         - 2.0 * center);
+
+    const size_t globalIndex = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    output[globalIndex] = cTile[tileIndex(muX + 1, muY + 1, muZ + 1,
+                                          C_TILE_X, C_TILE_Y)]
+                        + 0.01 * laplacianMu;
 }

+__device__ __forceinline__ size_t clampCoordinate(const long long coordinate,
+                                                  const size_t extent) {
+    if (coordinate <= 0) {
+        return 0;
     }
+    const size_t value = static_cast<size_t>(coordinate);
+    return value < extent ? value : extent - 1;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ double chemicalPotential(const double* __restrict__ c,
+                                                    const int x, const int y,
+                                                    const int z) {
+    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(x, y, z, C_TILE_X, C_TILE_Y);
+    const double center = c[centerIndex];
+    const double cxx = c[centerIndex + 1] + c[centerIndex - 1] - 2.0 * center;
+    const double cyy = c[centerIndex + C_TILE_X] + c[centerIndex - C_TILE_X]
+                     - 2.0 * center;
+    constexpr size_t cPlane = C_TILE_X * C_TILE_Y;
+    const double czz = c[centerIndex + cPlane] + c[centerIndex - cPlane]
+                     - 2.0 * center;
+
+    // With the benchmark's fixed interaction energies this is exactly the
+    // polynomial represented by the original bulk-energy expression.
+    const double bulk = center * center * center - center;
+    return bulk - 0.5 * (cxx + cyy + czz);
 }

+void computeChemicalPotentialKernel(double* __restrict__ mu,

+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(

+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(

+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + localZ - 1, nz);
+        cTile[linear] = input[globalZ * plane + globalY * nx + globalX];
     }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) return;
+

+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
+    const int tz = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(tx, ty, tz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y);
+    const double center = cTile[centerIndex];
+    const double cxx = cTile[centerIndex + 1] + cTile[centerIndex - 1]
+                     - 2.0 * center;
+    const double cyy = cTile[centerIndex + R1_TILE_X]
+                     + cTile[centerIndex - R1_TILE_X] - 2.0 * center;
+    constexpr size_t r1Plane = R1_TILE_X * R1_TILE_Y;
+    const double czz = cTile[centerIndex + r1Plane]
+                     + cTile[centerIndex - r1Plane] - 2.0 * center;
+    const double bulk = center * center * center - center;
+    mu[z * plane + y * nx + x] = bulk - 0.5 * (cxx + cyy + czz);
+}

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS, 6)
+void updateConcentrationKernel(double* __restrict__ output,
+                               const double* __restrict__ input,
+                               const double* __restrict__ mu,
+                               const size_t nx, const size_t ny,
+                               const size_t nz, const size_t plane) {
+    __shared__ double muTile[R1_TILE_SIZE];
+    const int tid = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x)
+                  + BLOCK_X * (static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y)
+                  + BLOCK_Y * static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z));
+    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
+    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
+    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
+
+    for (int linear = tid; linear < R1_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
+        const int localX = linear % R1_TILE_X;
+        const int yz = linear / R1_TILE_X;
+        const int localY = yz % R1_TILE_Y;
+        const int localZ = yz / R1_TILE_Y;
+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originX) + localX - 1, nx);
+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + localY - 1, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + localZ - 1, nz);
+        muTile[linear] = mu[globalZ * plane + globalY * nx + globalX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) return;
+
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
+    const int tz = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(tx, ty, tz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y);
+    const double center = muTile[centerIndex];
+    constexpr size_t r1Plane = R1_TILE_X * R1_TILE_Y;
+    const double laplacianMu =
+        (muTile[centerIndex + 1] + muTile[centerIndex - 1] - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[centerIndex + R1_TILE_X] + muTile[centerIndex - R1_TILE_X]
+         - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[centerIndex + r1Plane] + muTile[centerIndex - r1Plane]
+         - 2.0 * center);
+    const size_t globalIndex = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    output[globalIndex] = input[globalIndex] + 0.01 * laplacianMu;
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)
+void cahnHilliardStep(double* __restrict__ output,
+                      const double* __restrict__ input,
+                      const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+                      const size_t plane) {
+    __shared__ double shared[C_TILE_SIZE + MU_TILE_SIZE];
+    double* const cTile = shared;
+    double* const muTile = shared + C_TILE_SIZE;
+
+    const int tid = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x)
+                  + BLOCK_X * (static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y)
+                  + BLOCK_Y * static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z));
+    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
+    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
+    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
+
+    // Cooperatively stage the radius-two concentration tile.  Loading a
+    // clamped halo here gives the same zero-normal-gradient boundary rule as
+    // the original per-neighbor index clamping.
+    for (int linear = tid; linear < C_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
+        const int localX = linear % C_TILE_X;
+        const int yz = linear / C_TILE_X;
+        const int localY = yz % C_TILE_Y;
+        const int localZ = yz / C_TILE_Y;
+
+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originX) + localX - 2, nx);
+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + localY - 2, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + localZ - 2, nz);
+        cTile[linear] = input[globalZ * plane + globalY * nx + globalX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    // Form mu for the output tile and its one-cell halo.  The coordinate is
+    // clamped before locating its center in cTile; this detail is required at
+    // domain faces because Laplacian(mu) reuses mu at the boundary itself.
+    for (int linear = tid; linear < MU_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
+        const int muX = linear % MU_TILE_X;
+        const int yz = linear / MU_TILE_X;
+        const int muY = yz % MU_TILE_Y;
+        const int muZ = yz / MU_TILE_Y;
+
+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originX) + muX - 1, nx);
+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + muY - 1, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + muZ - 1, nz);
+
+        const int cX = static_cast<int>(globalX - originX) + 2;
+        const int cY = static_cast<int>(globalY - originY) + 2;
+        const int cZ = static_cast<int>(globalZ - originZ) + 2;
+        muTile[linear] = chemicalPotential(cTile, cX, cY, cZ);
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int muX = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;
+    const int muY = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
+    const int muZ = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t muCenter = tileIndex(muX, muY, muZ, MU_TILE_X, MU_TILE_Y);
+    constexpr size_t muPlane = MU_TILE_X * MU_TILE_Y;
+    const double center = muTile[muCenter];
+    const double laplacianMu =
+        (muTile[muCenter + 1] + muTile[muCenter - 1] - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[muCenter + MU_TILE_X] + muTile[muCenter - MU_TILE_X]
+         - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[muCenter + muPlane] + muTile[muCenter - muPlane]
+         - 2.0 * center);
+
+    const size_t globalIndex = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    output[globalIndex] = cTile[tileIndex(muX + 1, muY + 1, muZ + 1,
+                                          C_TILE_X, C_TILE_Y)]
+                        + 0.01 * laplacianMu;
 }

+__device__ __forceinline__ size_t clampCoordinate(const long long coordinate,
+                                                  const size_t extent) {
+    if (coordinate <= 0) {
+        return 0;
     }
+    const size_t value = static_cast<size_t>(coordinate);
+    return value < extent ? value : extent - 1;

+__device__ __forceinline__ double chemicalPotential(const double* __restrict__ c,
+                                                    const int x, const int y,
+                                                    const int z) {
+    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(x, y, z, C_TILE_X, C_TILE_Y);
+    const double center = c[centerIndex];
+    const double cxx = c[centerIndex + 1] + c[centerIndex - 1] - 2.0 * center;
+    const double cyy = c[centerIndex + C_TILE_X] + c[centerIndex - C_TILE_X]
+                     - 2.0 * center;
+    constexpr size_t cPlane = C_TILE_X * C_TILE_Y;
+    const double czz = c[centerIndex + cPlane] + c[centerIndex - cPlane]
+                     - 2.0 * center;
+
+    // With the benchmark's fixed interaction energies this is exactly the
+    // polynomial represented by the original bulk-energy expression.
+    const double bulk = center * center * center - center;
+    return bulk - 0.5 * (cxx + cyy + czz);

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS, 6)
+void computeChemicalPotentialKernel(double* __restrict__ mu,
+                                    const double* __restrict__ input,
+                                    const size_t nx, const size_t ny,
+                                    const size_t nz, const size_t plane) {
+    __shared__ double cTile[R1_TILE_SIZE];
+    const int tid = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x)
+                  + BLOCK_X * (static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y)
+                  + BLOCK_Y * static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z));
+    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
+    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;

+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + localY - 1, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + localZ - 1, nz);
+        cTile[linear] = input[globalZ * plane + globalY * nx + globalX];

+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) return;
+

+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;

+    const double czz = cTile[centerIndex + r1Plane]
+                     + cTile[centerIndex - r1Plane] - 2.0 * center;
+    const double bulk = center * center * center - center;
+    mu[z * plane + y * nx + x] = bulk - 0.5 * (cxx + cyy + czz);
+}
