+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)
+void computeChemicalPotentialKernel(double* __restrict__ mu,
+                                    const double* __restrict__ input,
+                                    const size_t nx, const size_t ny,
+                                    const size_t nz, const size_t plane) {
+    __shared__ double cTile[R1_TILE_SIZE];
+    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
+    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
+    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
+    stageRadiusOne(cTile, input, nx, ny, nz, plane);
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) return;
+
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
+    const int tz = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(tx, ty, tz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y);
+    const double center = cTile[centerIndex];
+    const double cxx = cTile[centerIndex + 1] + cTile[centerIndex - 1]
+                     - 2.0 * center;
+    const double cyy = cTile[centerIndex + R1_TILE_X]
+                     + cTile[centerIndex - R1_TILE_X] - 2.0 * center;
+    constexpr size_t r1Plane = R1_TILE_X * R1_TILE_Y;
+    const double czz = cTile[centerIndex + r1Plane]
+                     + cTile[centerIndex - r1Plane] - 2.0 * center;
+    const double bulk = center * center * center - center;
+    mu[z * plane + y * nx + x] = bulk - 0.5 * (cxx + cyy + czz);
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)
+void updateConcentrationKernel(double* __restrict__ output,
+                               const double* __restrict__ input,
+                               const double* __restrict__ mu,
+                               const size_t nx, const size_t ny,
+                               const size_t nz, const size_t plane) {
+    __shared__ double muTile[R1_TILE_SIZE];
+    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
+    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
+    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
+    stageRadiusOne(muTile, mu, nx, ny, nz, plane);
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) return;
+
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
+    const int tz = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(tx, ty, tz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y);
+    const double center = muTile[centerIndex];
+    constexpr size_t r1Plane = R1_TILE_X * R1_TILE_Y;
+    const double laplacianMu =
+        (muTile[centerIndex + 1] + muTile[centerIndex - 1] - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[centerIndex + R1_TILE_X] + muTile[centerIndex - R1_TILE_X]
+         - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[centerIndex + r1Plane] + muTile[centerIndex - r1Plane]
+         - 2.0 * center);
+    const size_t globalIndex = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    output[globalIndex] = input[globalIndex] + 0.01 * laplacianMu;
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)
+void cahnHilliardStep(double* __restrict__ output,
+                      const double* __restrict__ input,
+                      const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+                      const size_t plane) {
+    __shared__ double shared[C_TILE_SIZE + MU_TILE_SIZE];
+    double* const cTile = shared;
+    double* const muTile = shared + C_TILE_SIZE;
+
+    const int tid = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x)
+                  + BLOCK_X * (static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y)
+                  + BLOCK_Y * static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z));
+    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
+    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
+    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
+
+    // Cooperatively stage the radius-two concentration tile.  Loading a
+    // clamped halo here gives the same zero-normal-gradient boundary rule as
+    // the original per-neighbor index clamping.
+    for (int linear = tid; linear < C_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
+        const int localX = linear % C_TILE_X;
+        const int yz = linear / C_TILE_X;
+        const int localY = yz % C_TILE_Y;
+        const int localZ = yz / C_TILE_Y;
+
+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originX) + localX - 2, nx);
+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + localY - 2, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + localZ - 2, nz);
+        cTile[linear] = input[globalZ * plane + globalY * nx + globalX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    // Form mu for the output tile and its one-cell halo.  The coordinate is
+    // clamped before locating its center in cTile; this detail is required at
+    // domain faces because Laplacian(mu) reuses mu at the boundary itself.
+    for (int linear = tid; linear < MU_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
+        const int muX = linear % MU_TILE_X;
+        const int yz = linear / MU_TILE_X;
+        const int muY = yz % MU_TILE_Y;
+        const int muZ = yz / MU_TILE_Y;
+
+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originX) + muX - 1, nx);
+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + muY - 1, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + muZ - 1, nz);
+
+        const int cX = static_cast<int>(globalX - originX) + 2;
+        const int cY = static_cast<int>(globalY - originY) + 2;
+        const int cZ = static_cast<int>(globalZ - originZ) + 2;
+        muTile[linear] = chemicalPotential(cTile, cX, cY, cZ);
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) {
+        return;
     }
+
+    const int muX = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;
+    const int muY = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
+    const int muZ = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t muCenter = tileIndex(muX, muY, muZ, MU_TILE_X, MU_TILE_Y);
+    constexpr size_t muPlane = MU_TILE_X * MU_TILE_Y;
+    const double center = muTile[muCenter];
+    const double laplacianMu =
+        (muTile[muCenter + 1] + muTile[muCenter - 1] - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[muCenter + MU_TILE_X] + muTile[muCenter - MU_TILE_X]
+         - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[muCenter + muPlane] + muTile[muCenter - muPlane]
+         - 2.0 * center);
+
+    const size_t globalIndex = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    output[globalIndex] = cTile[tileIndex(muX + 1, muY + 1, muZ + 1,
+                                          C_TILE_X, C_TILE_Y)]
+                        + 0.01 * laplacianMu;
 }

+__device__ __forceinline__ double chemicalPotential(const double* __restrict__ c,
+                                                    const int x, const int y,
+                                                    const int z) {
+    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(x, y, z, C_TILE_X, C_TILE_Y);
+    const double center = c[centerIndex];
+    const double cxx = c[centerIndex + 1] + c[centerIndex - 1] - 2.0 * center;
+    const double cyy = c[centerIndex + C_TILE_X] + c[centerIndex - C_TILE_X]
+                     - 2.0 * center;
+    constexpr size_t cPlane = C_TILE_X * C_TILE_Y;
+    const double czz = c[centerIndex + cPlane] + c[centerIndex - cPlane]
+                     - 2.0 * center;
+
+    // With the benchmark's fixed interaction energies this is exactly the
+    // polynomial represented by the original bulk-energy expression.
+    const double bulk = center * center * center - center;
+    return bulk - 0.5 * (cxx + cyy + czz);

+    const bool zBoundaryThread = tz == 0 || tz == BLOCK_Z - 1;

+    // Each face/edge/corner is assigned to the corresponding boundary thread.
+    // This produces fully coalesced interior loads and avoids integer divide and
+    // remainder operations in the former flattened cooperative-loading loop.
+    if (xBoundaryThread) {
+        const bool low = tx == 0;
+        const size_t haloX = low ? (originX == 0 ? 0 : originX - 1)
+                                 : min(originX + BLOCK_X, nx - 1);
+        const int haloSx = low ? 0 : BLOCK_X + 1;
+        tile[tileIndex(haloSx, sy, sz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y)] =
+            gridValue(values, haloX, y, z, nx, plane);
+
+        if (yBoundaryThread) {
+            const bool yLow = ty == 0;
+            const size_t haloY = yLow ? (originY == 0 ? 0 : originY - 1)
+                                      : min(originY + BLOCK_Y, ny - 1);
+            const int haloSy = yLow ? 0 : BLOCK_Y + 1;
+            tile[tileIndex(haloSx, haloSy, sz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y)] =
+                gridValue(values, haloX, haloY, z, nx, plane);
+
+            if (zBoundaryThread) {
+                const bool zLow = tz == 0;
+                const size_t haloZ = zLow ? (originZ == 0 ? 0 : originZ - 1)
+                                          : min(originZ + BLOCK_Z, nz - 1);
+                const int haloSz = zLow ? 0 : BLOCK_Z + 1;
+                tile[tileIndex(haloSx, haloSy, haloSz,
+                               R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y)] =
+                    gridValue(values, haloX, haloY, haloZ, nx, plane);
             }
         }
+
+        if (zBoundaryThread) {
+            const bool zLow = tz == 0;
+            const size_t haloZ = zLow ? (originZ == 0 ? 0 : originZ - 1)
+                                      : min(originZ + BLOCK_Z, nz - 1);
+            const int haloSz = zLow ? 0 : BLOCK_Z + 1;
+            tile[tileIndex(haloSx, sy, haloSz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y)] =
+                gridValue(values, haloX, y, haloZ, nx, plane);
+        }
+    }
+
+    if (yBoundaryThread) {
+        const bool low = ty == 0;
+        const size_t haloY = low ? (originY == 0 ? 0 : originY - 1)
+                                 : min(originY + BLOCK_Y, ny - 1);
+        const int haloSy = low ? 0 : BLOCK_Y + 1;
+        tile[tileIndex(sx, haloSy, sz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y)] =
+            gridValue(values, x, haloY, z, nx, plane);
+
+        if (zBoundaryThread) {
+            const bool zLow = tz == 0;
+            const size_t haloZ = zLow ? (originZ == 0 ? 0 : originZ - 1)
+                                      : min(originZ + BLOCK_Z, nz - 1);
+            const int haloSz = zLow ? 0 : BLOCK_Z + 1;
+            tile[tileIndex(sx, haloSy, haloSz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y)] =
+                gridValue(values, x, haloY, haloZ, nx, plane);
+        }
+    }
+
+    if (zBoundaryThread) {
+        const bool low = tz == 0;
+        const size_t haloZ = low ? (originZ == 0 ? 0 : originZ - 1)
+                                 : min(originZ + BLOCK_Z, nz - 1);
+        const int haloSz = low ? 0 : BLOCK_Z + 1;
+        tile[tileIndex(sx, sy, haloSz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y)] =
+            gridValue(values, x, y, haloZ, nx, plane);
     }

-void cahnHilliardUpdate(std::vector<double>& cnew, const std::vector<double>& cold,

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)
+void computeChemicalPotentialKernel(double* __restrict__ mu,
+                                    const double* __restrict__ input,
+                                    const size_t nx, const size_t ny,
+                                    const size_t nz, const size_t plane) {
+    __shared__ double cTile[R1_TILE_SIZE];
+    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
+    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
+    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
+    stageRadiusOne(cTile, input, nx, ny, nz, plane);
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) return;
+
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
+    const int tz = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(tx, ty, tz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y);
+    const double center = cTile[centerIndex];
+    const double cxx = cTile[centerIndex + 1] + cTile[centerIndex - 1]
+                     - 2.0 * center;
+    const double cyy = cTile[centerIndex + R1_TILE_X]
+                     + cTile[centerIndex - R1_TILE_X] - 2.0 * center;
+    constexpr size_t r1Plane = R1_TILE_X * R1_TILE_Y;
+    const double czz = cTile[centerIndex + r1Plane]
+                     + cTile[centerIndex - r1Plane] - 2.0 * center;
+    const double bulk = center * center * center - center;
+    mu[z * plane + y * nx + x] = bulk - 0.5 * (cxx + cyy + czz);
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)
+void updateConcentrationKernel(double* __restrict__ output,
+                               const double* __restrict__ input,
+                               const double* __restrict__ mu,
+                               const size_t nx, const size_t ny,
+                               const size_t nz, const size_t plane) {
+    __shared__ double muTile[R1_TILE_SIZE];
+    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
+    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
+    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
+    stageRadiusOne(muTile, mu, nx, ny, nz, plane);
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) return;
+
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
+    const int tz = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(tx, ty, tz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y);
+    const double center = muTile[centerIndex];
+    constexpr size_t r1Plane = R1_TILE_X * R1_TILE_Y;
+    const double laplacianMu =
+        (muTile[centerIndex + 1] + muTile[centerIndex - 1] - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[centerIndex + R1_TILE_X] + muTile[centerIndex - R1_TILE_X]
+         - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[centerIndex + r1Plane] + muTile[centerIndex - r1Plane]
+         - 2.0 * center);
+    const size_t globalIndex = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    output[globalIndex] = input[globalIndex] + 0.01 * laplacianMu;
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)
+void cahnHilliardStep(double* __restrict__ output,
+                      const double* __restrict__ input,
+                      const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+                      const size_t plane) {
+    __shared__ double shared[C_TILE_SIZE + MU_TILE_SIZE];
+    double* const cTile = shared;
+    double* const muTile = shared + C_TILE_SIZE;
+
+    const int tid = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x)
+                  + BLOCK_X * (static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y)
+                  + BLOCK_Y * static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z));
+    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
+    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
+    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
+
+    // Cooperatively stage the radius-two concentration tile.  Loading a
+    // clamped halo here gives the same zero-normal-gradient boundary rule as
+    // the original per-neighbor index clamping.
+    for (int linear = tid; linear < C_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
+        const int localX = linear % C_TILE_X;
+        const int yz = linear / C_TILE_X;
+        const int localY = yz % C_TILE_Y;
+        const int localZ = yz / C_TILE_Y;
+
+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originX) + localX - 2, nx);
+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + localY - 2, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + localZ - 2, nz);
+        cTile[linear] = input[globalZ * plane + globalY * nx + globalX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    // Form mu for the output tile and its one-cell halo.  The coordinate is
+    // clamped before locating its center in cTile; this detail is required at
+    // domain faces because Laplacian(mu) reuses mu at the boundary itself.
+    for (int linear = tid; linear < MU_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
+        const int muX = linear % MU_TILE_X;
+        const int yz = linear / MU_TILE_X;
+        const int muY = yz % MU_TILE_Y;
+        const int muZ = yz / MU_TILE_Y;
+
+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originX) + muX - 1, nx);
+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + muY - 1, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + muZ - 1, nz);
+
+        const int cX = static_cast<int>(globalX - originX) + 2;
+        const int cY = static_cast<int>(globalY - originY) + 2;
+        const int cZ = static_cast<int>(globalZ - originZ) + 2;
+        muTile[linear] = chemicalPotential(cTile, cX, cY, cZ);
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) {
+        return;
     }
+
+    const int muX = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;
+    const int muY = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
+    const int muZ = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t muCenter = tileIndex(muX, muY, muZ, MU_TILE_X, MU_TILE_Y);
+    constexpr size_t muPlane = MU_TILE_X * MU_TILE_Y;
+    const double center = muTile[muCenter];
+    const double laplacianMu =
+        (muTile[muCenter + 1] + muTile[muCenter - 1] - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[muCenter + MU_TILE_X] + muTile[muCenter - MU_TILE_X]
+         - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[muCenter + muPlane] + muTile[muCenter - muPlane]
+         - 2.0 * center);
+
+    const size_t globalIndex = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    output[globalIndex] = cTile[tileIndex(muX + 1, muY + 1, muZ + 1,
+                                          C_TILE_X, C_TILE_Y)]
+                        + 0.01 * laplacianMu;
 }

    15	// A 32-wide X dimension makes every row access coalesced.  The two-cell
    16	// concentration halo is enough to form the one-cell chemical-potential halo,
    17	// so a complete time step needs only one kernel and no global mu array.

    48	__device__ __forceinline__ size_t tileIndex(const int x, const int y, const int z,
    49	                                            const int sx, const int sy) {
    50	    return (static_cast<size_t>(z) * sy + y) * sx + x;
    51	}

    53	__device__ __forceinline__ size_t clampCoordinate(const long long coordinate,
    54	                                                  const size_t extent) {
    55	    if (coordinate <= 0) {
    56	        return 0;
    57	    }
    58	    const size_t value = static_cast<size_t>(coordinate);
    59	    return value < extent ? value : extent - 1;
    60	}

    62	__device__ __forceinline__ double chemicalPotential(const double* __restrict__ c,
    63	                                                    const int x, const int y,
    64	                                                    const int z) {
    65	    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(x, y, z, C_TILE_X, C_TILE_Y);
    66	    const double center = c[centerIndex];
    67	    const double cxx = c[centerIndex + 1] + c[centerIndex - 1] - 2.0 * center;
    68	    const double cyy = c[centerIndex + C_TILE_X] + c[centerIndex - C_TILE_X]
    69	                     - 2.0 * center;
    70	    constexpr size_t cPlane = C_TILE_X * C_TILE_Y;
    71	    const double czz = c[centerIndex + cPlane] + c[centerIndex - cPlane]
    72	                     - 2.0 * center;
    73	
    74	    // With the benchmark's fixed interaction energies this is exactly the
    75	    // polynomial represented by the original bulk-energy expression.
    76	    const double bulk = center * center * center - center;
    77	    return bulk - 0.5 * (cxx + cyy + czz);
    78	}

    86	                                            const size_t x, const size_t y,
    87	                                            const size_t z, const size_t nx,

    92	__device__ __forceinline__ void stageRadiusOne(double* __restrict__ tile,
    93	                                               const double* __restrict__ values,
    94	                                               const size_t nx, const size_t ny,
    95	                                               const size_t nz,
    96	                                               const size_t plane) {
    97	    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
    98	    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y);
    99	    const int tz = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z);
   100	    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
   101	    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
   102	    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
   103	    const size_t x = min(originX + static_cast<size_t>(tx), nx - 1);
   104	    const size_t y = min(originY + static_cast<size_t>(ty), ny - 1);
   105	    const size_t z = min(originZ + static_cast<size_t>(tz), nz - 1);
   106	    const int sx = tx + 1;
   107	    const int sy = ty + 1;
   108	    const int sz = tz + 1;
   109	
   110	    tile[tileIndex(sx, sy, sz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y)] =
   111	        gridValue(values, x, y, z, nx, plane);
   112	
   113	    const bool xBoundaryThread = tx == 0 || tx == BLOCK_X - 1;
   114	    const bool yBoundaryThread = ty == 0 || ty == BLOCK_Y - 1;
   115	    const bool zBoundaryThread = tz == 0 || tz == BLOCK_Z - 1;
   116	
   117	    // Each face/edge/corner is assigned to the corresponding boundary thread.
   118	    // This produces fully coalesced interior loads and avoids integer divide and
   119	    // remainder operations in the former flattened cooperative-loading loop.
   120	    if (xBoundaryThread) {
   121	        const bool low = tx == 0;
   122	        const size_t haloX = low ? (originX == 0 ? 0 : originX - 1)
   123	                                 : min(originX + BLOCK_X, nx - 1);
   124	        const int haloSx = low ? 0 : BLOCK_X + 1;
   125	        tile[tileIndex(haloSx, sy, sz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y)] =
   126	            gridValue(values, haloX, y, z, nx, plane);
   127	
   128	        if (yBoundaryThread) {
   129	            const bool yLow = ty == 0;
   130	            const size_t haloY = yLow ? (originY == 0 ? 0 : originY - 1)
   131	                                      : min(originY + BLOCK_Y, ny - 1);
   132	            const int haloSy = yLow ? 0 : BLOCK_Y + 1;
   133	            tile[tileIndex(haloSx, haloSy, sz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y)] =
   134	                gridValue(values, haloX, haloY, z, nx, plane);
   135	
   136	            if (zBoundaryThread) {
   137	                const bool zLow = tz == 0;
   138	                const size_t haloZ = zLow ? (originZ == 0 ? 0 : originZ - 1)
   139	                                          : min(originZ + BLOCK_Z, nz - 1);
   140	                const int haloSz = zLow ? 0 : BLOCK_Z + 1;
   141	                tile[tileIndex(haloSx, haloSy, haloSz,
   142	                               R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y)] =
   143	                    gridValue(values, haloX, haloY, haloZ, nx, plane);
   144	            }
   145	        }
   146	
   147	        if (zBoundaryThread) {
   148	            const bool zLow = tz == 0;
   149	            const size_t haloZ = zLow ? (originZ == 0 ? 0 : originZ - 1)
   150	                                      : min(originZ + BLOCK_Z, nz - 1);
   151	            const int haloSz = zLow ? 0 : BLOCK_Z + 1;
   152	            tile[tileIndex(haloSx, sy, haloSz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y)] =
   153	                gridValue(values, haloX, y, haloZ, nx, plane);
   154	        }
   155	    }
   156	
   157	    if (yBoundaryThread) {
   158	        const bool low = ty == 0;
   159	        const size_t haloY = low ? (originY == 0 ? 0 : originY - 1)
   160	                                 : min(originY + BLOCK_Y, ny - 1);
   161	        const int haloSy = low ? 0 : BLOCK_Y + 1;
   162	        tile[tileIndex(sx, haloSy, sz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y)] =
   163	            gridValue(values, x, haloY, z, nx, plane);
   164	
   165	        if (zBoundaryThread) {
   166	            const bool zLow = tz == 0;
   167	            const size_t haloZ = zLow ? (originZ == 0 ? 0 : originZ - 1)
   168	                                      : min(originZ + BLOCK_Z, nz - 1);
   169	            const int haloSz = zLow ? 0 : BLOCK_Z + 1;
   170	            tile[tileIndex(sx, haloSy, haloSz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y)] =
   171	                gridValue(values, x, haloY, haloZ, nx, plane);
   172	        }
   173	    }
   174	
   175	    if (zBoundaryThread) {
   176	        const bool low = tz == 0;
   177	        const size_t haloZ = low ? (originZ == 0 ? 0 : originZ - 1)
   178	                                 : min(originZ + BLOCK_Z, nz - 1);
   179	        const int haloSz = low ? 0 : BLOCK_Z + 1;
   180	        tile[tileIndex(sx, sy, haloSz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y)] =
   181	            gridValue(values, x, y, haloZ, nx, plane);
   182	    }
   183	}

   185	__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)
   186	void computeChemicalPotentialKernel(double* __restrict__ mu,
   187	                                    const double* __restrict__ input,
   188	                                    const size_t nx, const size_t ny,
   189	                                    const size_t nz, const size_t plane) {
   190	    __shared__ double cTile[R1_TILE_SIZE];
   191	    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
   192	    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
   193	    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
   194	    stageRadiusOne(cTile, input, nx, ny, nz, plane);
   195	    __syncthreads();
   196	
   197	    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
   198	    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
   199	    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
   200	    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) return;
   201	
   202	    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;
   203	    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
   204	    const int tz = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
   205	    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(tx, ty, tz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y);
   206	    const double center = cTile[centerIndex];
   207	    const double cxx = cTile[centerIndex + 1] + cTile[centerIndex - 1]
   208	                     - 2.0 * center;
   209	    const double cyy = cTile[centerIndex + R1_TILE_X]
   210	                     + cTile[centerIndex - R1_TILE_X] - 2.0 * center;
   211	    constexpr size_t r1Plane = R1_TILE_X * R1_TILE_Y;
   212	    const double czz = cTile[centerIndex + r1Plane]
   213	                     + cTile[centerIndex - r1Plane] - 2.0 * center;
   214	    const double bulk = center * center * center - center;
   215	    mu[z * plane + y * nx + x] = bulk - 0.5 * (cxx + cyy + czz);
   216	}
   217	
   218	__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)
   219	void updateConcentrationKernel(double* __restrict__ output,
   220	                               const double* __restrict__ input,
   221	                               const double* __restrict__ mu,
   222	                               const size_t nx, const size_t ny,
   223	                               const size_t nz, const size_t plane) {
   224	    __shared__ double muTile[R1_TILE_SIZE];
   225	    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
   226	    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
   227	    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
   228	    stageRadiusOne(muTile, mu, nx, ny, nz, plane);
   229	    __syncthreads();
   230	
   231	    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
   232	    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
   233	    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
   234	    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) return;
   235	
   236	    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;
   237	    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
   238	    const int tz = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
   239	    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(tx, ty, tz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y);
   240	    const double center = muTile[centerIndex];
   241	    constexpr size_t r1Plane = R1_TILE_X * R1_TILE_Y;
   242	    const double laplacianMu =
   243	        (muTile[centerIndex + 1] + muTile[centerIndex - 1] - 2.0 * center) +
   244	        (muTile[centerIndex + R1_TILE_X] + muTile[centerIndex - R1_TILE_X]
   245	         - 2.0 * center) +
   246	        (muTile[centerIndex + r1Plane] + muTile[centerIndex - r1Plane]
   247	         - 2.0 * center);
   248	    const size_t globalIndex = z * plane + y * nx + x;
   249	    output[globalIndex] = input[globalIndex] + 0.01 * laplacianMu;
   250	}
   251	
   252	__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)
   253	void cahnHilliardStep(double* __restrict__ output,
   254	                      const double* __restrict__ input,
   255	                      const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
   256	                      const size_t plane) {
   257	    __shared__ double shared[C_TILE_SIZE + MU_TILE_SIZE];
   258	    double* const cTile = shared;
   259	    double* const muTile = shared + C_TILE_SIZE;
   260	
   261	    const int tid = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x)
   262	                  + BLOCK_X * (static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y)
   263	                  + BLOCK_Y * static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z));
   264	    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
   265	    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
   266	    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
   267	
   268	    // Cooperatively stage the radius-two concentration tile.  Loading a
   269	    // clamped halo here gives the same zero-normal-gradient boundary rule as
   270	    // the original per-neighbor index clamping.
   271	    for (int linear = tid; linear < C_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
   272	        const int localX = linear % C_TILE_X;
   273	        const int yz = linear / C_TILE_X;
   274	        const int localY = yz % C_TILE_Y;
   275	        const int localZ = yz / C_TILE_Y;
   276	
   277	        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
   278	            static_cast<long long>(originX) + localX - 2, nx);
   279	        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
   280	            static_cast<long long>(originY) + localY - 2, ny);
   281	        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
   282	            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + localZ - 2, nz);
   283	        cTile[linear] = input[globalZ * plane + globalY * nx + globalX];
   284	    }
   285	    __syncthreads();
   286	
   287	    // Form mu for the output tile and its one-cell halo.  The coordinate is
   288	    // clamped before locating its center in cTile; this detail is required at
   289	    // domain faces because Laplacian(mu) reuses mu at the boundary itself.
   290	    for (int linear = tid; linear < MU_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
   291	        const int muX = linear % MU_TILE_X;
   292	        const int yz = linear / MU_TILE_X;
   293	        const int muY = yz % MU_TILE_Y;
   294	        const int muZ = yz / MU_TILE_Y;
   295	
   296	        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
   297	            static_cast<long long>(originX) + muX - 1, nx);
   298	        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
   299	            static_cast<long long>(originY) + muY - 1, ny);
   300	        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
   301	            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + muZ - 1, nz);
   302	
   303	        const int cX = static_cast<int>(globalX - originX) + 2;
   304	        const int cY = static_cast<int>(globalY - originY) + 2;
   305	        const int cZ = static_cast<int>(globalZ - originZ) + 2;
   306	        muTile[linear] = chemicalPotential(cTile, cX, cY, cZ);
   307	    }
   308	    __syncthreads();
   309	
   310	    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
   311	    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
   312	    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
   313	    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) {
   314	        return;
   315	    }
   316	
   317	    const int muX = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;
   318	    const int muY = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
   319	    const int muZ = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
   320	    const size_t muCenter = tileIndex(muX, muY, muZ, MU_TILE_X, MU_TILE_Y);
   321	    constexpr size_t muPlane = MU_TILE_X * MU_TILE_Y;
   322	    const double center = muTile[muCenter];
   323	    const double laplacianMu =
   324	        (muTile[muCenter + 1] + muTile[muCenter - 1] - 2.0 * center) +
   325	        (muTile[muCenter + MU_TILE_X] + muTile[muCenter - MU_TILE_X]
   326	         - 2.0 * center) +
   327	        (muTile[muCenter + muPlane] + muTile[muCenter - muPlane]
   328	         - 2.0 * center);
   329	
   330	    const size_t globalIndex = z * plane + y * nx + x;
   331	    output[globalIndex] = cTile[tileIndex(muX + 1, muY + 1, muZ + 1,
   332	                                          C_TILE_X, C_TILE_Y)]
   333	                        + 0.01 * laplacianMu;
   334	}

   336	void initializeConcentration(std::vector<double>& c) {
   337	    const size_t volume = c.size();
   338	    for (size_t linearId = 0; linearId < volume; ++linearId) {
   339	        const double pseudo = ((linearId + 1) * size_t{1299709} % volume)
   340	                            / static_cast<double>(volume);
   341	        c[linearId] = -1.0 + 2.0 * pseudo;
   342	    }
   343	}
   344	
   345	bool validateResult(const std::vector<double>& c) {
   346	    for (const double value : c) {
   347	        if (!std::isfinite(value)) {
   348	            std::printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\n");
   349	            return false;
   350	        }
   351	    }
   352	
   353	    const auto [minimum, maximum] = std::minmax_element(c.begin(), c.end());
   354	    std::printf("Concentration range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", *minimum, *maximum);
   355	    if (*maximum > 10.0 || *minimum < -10.0) {
   356	        std::printf("Validation failed: values out of expected range\n");
   357	        return false;
   358	    }
   359	    return true;
   360	}

   368	    std::printf("  -i <num>     Number of time steps (default: 20)\n");
   369	    std::printf("  -v           Enable validation\n");
   370	    std::printf("  -r           Print results for external validation\n");
   371	    std::printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");

   374	bool checkedMultiply(const size_t a, const size_t b, size_t& result) {
   375	    if (a != 0 && b > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / a) {
   376	        return false;
   377	    }
   378	    result = a * b;
   379	    return true;
   380	}

   384	int main(int argc, char** argv) {
   385	    size_t nx = 64;
   386	    size_t ny = 0;
   387	    size_t nz = 0;
   388	    int iterations = 20;
   389	    bool validate = false;
   390	    bool printResults = false;
   391	
   392	    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
   393	        if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-x") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
   394	            nx = std::strtoull(argv[++i], nullptr, 10);
   395	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-y") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
   396	            ny = std::strtoull(argv[++i], nullptr, 10);
   397	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-z") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
   398	            nz = std::strtoull(argv[++i], nullptr, 10);
   399	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-i") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
   400	            iterations = std::atoi(argv[++i]);
   401	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-v") == 0) {
   402	            validate = true;
   403	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-r") == 0) {
   404	            printResults = true;
   405	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-h") == 0) {
   406	            printUsage(argv[0]);
   407	            return EXIT_SUCCESS;
   408	        } else {
   409	            std::printf("Unknown option: %s\n", argv[i]);
   410	            printUsage(argv[0]);
   411	            return EXIT_FAILURE;
   412	        }
   413	    }
   414	
   415	    if (ny == 0) ny = nx;
   416	    if (nz == 0) nz = nx;
   417	    if (nx == 0 || ny == 0 || nz == 0 || iterations < 0) {
   418	        std::fprintf(stderr, "Grid dimensions must be positive and iterations non-negative.\n");
   419	        return EXIT_FAILURE;
   420	    }
   420	    }
   421	
   422	    size_t plane = 0;
   423	    size_t gridSize = 0;
   424	    if (!checkedMultiply(nx, ny, plane) || !checkedMultiply(plane, nz, gridSize)
   425	        || gridSize > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / sizeof(double)) {
   426	        std::fprintf(stderr, "Requested grid is too large.\n");
   427	        return EXIT_FAILURE;
   428	    }
   429	
   430	    std::printf("Cahn-Hilliard Phase Separation Benchmark\n");
   431	    std::printf("Grid size: %zu x %zu x %zu\n", nx, ny, nz);
   432	    std::printf("Time steps: %d\n", iterations);
   433	    std::printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
   434	
   435	    std::vector<double> concentration(gridSize);
   436	    std::printf("Initializing concentration field...\n");
   437	    initializeConcentration(concentration);
   438	
   439	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(0));
   440	    cudaDeviceProp deviceProperties{};
   441	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&deviceProperties, 0));
   442	
   443	    const size_t blocksX = (nx + BLOCK_X - 1) / BLOCK_X;
   444	    const size_t blocksY = (ny + BLOCK_Y - 1) / BLOCK_Y;
   445	    const size_t blocksZ = (nz + BLOCK_Z - 1) / BLOCK_Z;
   446	    if (blocksX > static_cast<size_t>(deviceProperties.maxGridSize[0])
   447	        || blocksY > static_cast<size_t>(deviceProperties.maxGridSize[1])
   448	        || blocksZ > static_cast<size_t>(deviceProperties.maxGridSize[2])) {
   449	        std::fprintf(stderr, "Requested grid exceeds this GPU's launch limits.\n");
   450	        return EXIT_FAILURE;
   451	    }
   452	
   453	    double* deviceCurrent = nullptr;
   454	    double* deviceNext = nullptr;
   455	    double* deviceMu = nullptr;
   456	    const size_t bytes = gridSize * sizeof(double);
   457	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&deviceCurrent), bytes));
   458	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&deviceNext), bytes));
   459	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&deviceMu), bytes));
   460	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(deviceCurrent, concentration.data(), bytes,
   461	                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   462	
   463	    // Favor shared memory over L1: every staged value is deliberately reused,
   464	    // whereas the global concentration stream is consumed only once per tile.
   465	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFuncSetCacheConfig(cahnHilliardStep, cudaFuncCachePreferShared));
   466	
   467	    const dim3 threads(BLOCK_X, BLOCK_Y, BLOCK_Z);
   468	    const dim3 blocks(static_cast<unsigned>(blocksX),
   469	                      static_cast<unsigned>(blocksY),
   470	                      static_cast<unsigned>(blocksZ));
   471	    cudaEvent_t startEvent{};
   472	    cudaEvent_t stopEvent{};
   473	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreate(&startEvent));
   474	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreate(&stopEvent));
   475	
   476	    std::printf("Running Cahn-Hilliard simulation...\n");
   477	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(startEvent));
   478	    for (int step = 0; step < iterations; ++step) {
   479	        computeChemicalPotentialKernel<<<blocks, threads>>>(deviceMu, deviceCurrent,
   480	                                                            nx, ny, nz, plane);
   481	        updateConcentrationKernel<<<blocks, threads>>>(deviceNext, deviceCurrent,
   482	                                                       deviceMu, nx, ny, nz, plane);
   483	        std::swap(deviceCurrent, deviceNext);
   484	    }
   485	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   486	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(stopEvent));
   487	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(stopEvent));
   488	
   489	    float elapsedMilliseconds = 0.0F;
   490	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventElapsedTime(&elapsedMilliseconds, startEvent, stopEvent));
   491	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(concentration.data(), deviceCurrent, bytes,
   492	                          cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   493	
   494	    std::printf("Computation time: %.3f ms\n", elapsedMilliseconds);
   495	    const double cellUpdates = static_cast<double>(gridSize)
   496	                             * static_cast<double>(iterations);
   497	    const double mcups = cellUpdates / (static_cast<double>(elapsedMilliseconds) * 1000.0);
   498	    std::printf("Performance: %.3f MCellUpdates/s\n", mcups);
   499	
   500	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(startEvent));
   501	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(stopEvent));
   502	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceCurrent));
   503	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceNext));
   504	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceMu));
   505	
   506	    if (printResults) {
   507	        print_results(concentration, "Concentration");
   508	    }
   509	
   510	    if (validate) {
   511	        std::printf("Validating result...\n");
   512	        if (validateResult(concentration)) {
   513	            std::printf("Validation: PASSED\n");
   514	            return EXIT_SUCCESS;
   515	        }
   516	        std::printf("Validation: FAILED\n");
   517	        return EXIT_FAILURE;
   518	    }
   519	
   520	    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
   521	}

+    if (coordinate <= 0) {

+__device__ __forceinline__ double chemicalPotential(const double* __restrict__ c,
+                                                    const int x, const int y,
+                                                    const int z) {
+    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(x, y, z, C_TILE_X, C_TILE_Y);
+    const double center = c[centerIndex];
+    const double cxx = c[centerIndex + 1] + c[centerIndex - 1] - 2.0 * center;
+    const double cyy = c[centerIndex + C_TILE_X] + c[centerIndex - C_TILE_X]
+                     - 2.0 * center;

+    // polynomial represented by the original bulk-energy expression.

+                                            const size_t z, const size_t nx,
+                                            const size_t plane) {

+__device__ __forceinline__ void stageRadiusOne(double* __restrict__ tile,
+                                               const double* __restrict__ values,
+                                               const size_t nx, const size_t ny,
+                                               const size_t nz,
+                                               const size_t plane) {
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y);
+    const int tz = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z);
+    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
+    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
+    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
+    const size_t x = min(originX + static_cast<size_t>(tx), nx - 1);
+    const size_t y = min(originY + static_cast<size_t>(ty), ny - 1);
+    const size_t z = min(originZ + static_cast<size_t>(tz), nz - 1);
+    const int sx = tx + 1;
+    const int sy = ty + 1;
+    const int sz = tz + 1;
+
+    tile[tileIndex(sx, sy, sz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y)] =
+        gridValue(values, x, y, z, nx, plane);
+
+    const bool xBoundaryThread = tx == 0 || tx == BLOCK_X - 1;
+    const bool yBoundaryThread = ty == 0 || ty == BLOCK_Y - 1;
+    const bool zBoundaryThread = tz == 0 || tz == BLOCK_Z - 1;
+

+    // This produces fully coalesced interior loads and avoids integer divide and
+    // remainder operations in the former flattened cooperative-loading loop.

+        const size_t haloX = low ? (originX == 0 ? 0 : originX - 1)
+                                 : min(originX + BLOCK_X, nx - 1);
+        const int haloSx = low ? 0 : BLOCK_X + 1;
+        tile[tileIndex(haloSx, sy, sz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y)] =
+            gridValue(values, haloX, y, z, nx, plane);
+
+        if (yBoundaryThread) {
+            const bool yLow = ty == 0;
+            const size_t haloY = yLow ? (originY == 0 ? 0 : originY - 1)
+                                      : min(originY + BLOCK_Y, ny - 1);
+            const int haloSy = yLow ? 0 : BLOCK_Y + 1;
+            tile[tileIndex(haloSx, haloSy, sz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y)] =
+                gridValue(values, haloX, haloY, z, nx, plane);
+
+            if (zBoundaryThread) {
+                const bool zLow = tz == 0;
+                const size_t haloZ = zLow ? (originZ == 0 ? 0 : originZ - 1)
+                                          : min(originZ + BLOCK_Z, nz - 1);
+                const int haloSz = zLow ? 0 : BLOCK_Z + 1;
+                tile[tileIndex(haloSx, haloSy, haloSz,
+                               R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y)] =
+                    gridValue(values, haloX, haloY, haloZ, nx, plane);
             }
         }
+
+        if (zBoundaryThread) {
+            const bool zLow = tz == 0;
+            const size_t haloZ = zLow ? (originZ == 0 ? 0 : originZ - 1)
+                                      : min(originZ + BLOCK_Z, nz - 1);
+            const int haloSz = zLow ? 0 : BLOCK_Z + 1;
+            tile[tileIndex(haloSx, sy, haloSz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y)] =
+                gridValue(values, haloX, y, haloZ, nx, plane);
+        }
+    }
+
+    if (yBoundaryThread) {
+        const bool low = ty == 0;
+        const size_t haloY = low ? (originY == 0 ? 0 : originY - 1)
+                                 : min(originY + BLOCK_Y, ny - 1);
+        const int haloSy = low ? 0 : BLOCK_Y + 1;
+        tile[tileIndex(sx, haloSy, sz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y)] =
+            gridValue(values, x, haloY, z, nx, plane);

+        if (zBoundaryThread) {

+    }

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)
+void computeChemicalPotentialKernel(double* __restrict__ mu,
+                                    const double* __restrict__ input,
+                                    const size_t nx, const size_t ny,
+                                    const size_t nz, const size_t plane) {
+    __shared__ double cTile[R1_TILE_SIZE];
+    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
+    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
+    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
+    stageRadiusOne(cTile, input, nx, ny, nz, plane);
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) return;
+
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
+    const int tz = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(tx, ty, tz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y);
+    const double center = cTile[centerIndex];
+    const double cxx = cTile[centerIndex + 1] + cTile[centerIndex - 1]
+                     - 2.0 * center;
+    const double cyy = cTile[centerIndex + R1_TILE_X]
+                     + cTile[centerIndex - R1_TILE_X] - 2.0 * center;
+    constexpr size_t r1Plane = R1_TILE_X * R1_TILE_Y;
+    const double czz = cTile[centerIndex + r1Plane]
+                     + cTile[centerIndex - r1Plane] - 2.0 * center;
+    const double bulk = center * center * center - center;
+    mu[z * plane + y * nx + x] = bulk - 0.5 * (cxx + cyy + czz);
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)
+void updateConcentrationKernel(double* __restrict__ output,
+                               const double* __restrict__ input,
+                               const double* __restrict__ mu,
+                               const size_t nx, const size_t ny,
+                               const size_t nz, const size_t plane) {
+    __shared__ double muTile[R1_TILE_SIZE];
+    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
+    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
+    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
+    stageRadiusOne(muTile, mu, nx, ny, nz, plane);
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) return;
+
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
+    const int tz = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(tx, ty, tz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y);
+    const double center = muTile[centerIndex];
+    constexpr size_t r1Plane = R1_TILE_X * R1_TILE_Y;
+    const double laplacianMu =
+        (muTile[centerIndex + 1] + muTile[centerIndex - 1] - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[centerIndex + R1_TILE_X] + muTile[centerIndex - R1_TILE_X]
+         - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[centerIndex + r1Plane] + muTile[centerIndex - r1Plane]
+         - 2.0 * center);
+    const size_t globalIndex = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    output[globalIndex] = input[globalIndex] + 0.01 * laplacianMu;
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)
+void cahnHilliardStep(double* __restrict__ output,
+                      const double* __restrict__ input,
+                      const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+                      const size_t plane) {
+    __shared__ double shared[C_TILE_SIZE + MU_TILE_SIZE];
+    double* const cTile = shared;
+    double* const muTile = shared + C_TILE_SIZE;
+
+    const int tid = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x)
+                  + BLOCK_X * (static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y)
+                  + BLOCK_Y * static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z));
+    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
+    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
+    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
+
+    // Cooperatively stage the radius-two concentration tile.  Loading a
+    // clamped halo here gives the same zero-normal-gradient boundary rule as
+    // the original per-neighbor index clamping.
+    for (int linear = tid; linear < C_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
+        const int localX = linear % C_TILE_X;
+        const int yz = linear / C_TILE_X;
+        const int localY = yz % C_TILE_Y;
+        const int localZ = yz / C_TILE_Y;
+
+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originX) + localX - 2, nx);
+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + localY - 2, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + localZ - 2, nz);
+        cTile[linear] = input[globalZ * plane + globalY * nx + globalX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    // Form mu for the output tile and its one-cell halo.  The coordinate is
+    // clamped before locating its center in cTile; this detail is required at
+    // domain faces because Laplacian(mu) reuses mu at the boundary itself.
+    for (int linear = tid; linear < MU_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
+        const int muX = linear % MU_TILE_X;
+        const int yz = linear / MU_TILE_X;
+        const int muY = yz % MU_TILE_Y;
+        const int muZ = yz / MU_TILE_Y;
+
+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originX) + muX - 1, nx);
+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + muY - 1, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + muZ - 1, nz);
+
+        const int cX = static_cast<int>(globalX - originX) + 2;
+        const int cY = static_cast<int>(globalY - originY) + 2;
+        const int cZ = static_cast<int>(globalZ - originZ) + 2;
+        muTile[linear] = chemicalPotential(cTile, cX, cY, cZ);
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) {
+        return;
     }
+
+    const int muX = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;
+    const int muY = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
+    const int muZ = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t muCenter = tileIndex(muX, muY, muZ, MU_TILE_X, MU_TILE_Y);
+    constexpr size_t muPlane = MU_TILE_X * MU_TILE_Y;
+    const double center = muTile[muCenter];
+    const double laplacianMu =
+        (muTile[muCenter + 1] + muTile[muCenter - 1] - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[muCenter + MU_TILE_X] + muTile[muCenter - MU_TILE_X]
+         - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[muCenter + muPlane] + muTile[muCenter - muPlane]
+         - 2.0 * center);
+
+    const size_t globalIndex = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    output[globalIndex] = cTile[tileIndex(muX + 1, muY + 1, muZ + 1,
+                                          C_TILE_X, C_TILE_Y)]
+                        + 0.01 * laplacianMu;
 }

+__device__ __forceinline__ double chemicalPotential(const double* __restrict__ c,
+                                                    const int x, const int y,
+                                                    const int z) {
+    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(x, y, z, C_TILE_X, C_TILE_Y);
+    const double center = c[centerIndex];
+    const double cxx = c[centerIndex + 1] + c[centerIndex - 1] - 2.0 * center;
+    const double cyy = c[centerIndex + C_TILE_X] + c[centerIndex - C_TILE_X]
+                     - 2.0 * center;
+    constexpr size_t cPlane = C_TILE_X * C_TILE_Y;
+    const double czz = c[centerIndex + cPlane] + c[centerIndex - cPlane]
+                     - 2.0 * center;
+
+    // With the benchmark's fixed interaction energies this is exactly the
+    // polynomial represented by the original bulk-energy expression.
+    const double bulk = center * center * center - center;
+    return bulk - 0.5 * (cxx + cyy + czz);
+}
+
+constexpr int R1_TILE_X = BLOCK_X + 2;
+constexpr int R1_TILE_Y = BLOCK_Y + 2;
+constexpr int R1_TILE_Z = BLOCK_Z + 2;
+constexpr int R1_TILE_SIZE = R1_TILE_X * R1_TILE_Y * R1_TILE_Z;
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ double gridValue(const double* __restrict__ values,
+                                            const size_t x, const size_t y,
+                                            const size_t z, const size_t nx,
+                                            const size_t plane) {
+    return values[z * plane + y * nx + x];
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void stageRadiusOne(double* __restrict__ tile,
+                                               const double* __restrict__ values,
+                                               const size_t nx, const size_t ny,
+                                               const size_t nz,
+                                               const size_t plane) {
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y);
+    const int tz = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z);
+    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
+    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
+    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
+    const size_t x = min(originX + static_cast<size_t>(tx), nx - 1);
+    const size_t y = min(originY + static_cast<size_t>(ty), ny - 1);
+    const size_t z = min(originZ + static_cast<size_t>(tz), nz - 1);
+    const int sx = tx + 1;
+    const int sy = ty + 1;
+    const int sz = tz + 1;
+
+    tile[tileIndex(sx, sy, sz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y)] =
+        gridValue(values, x, y, z, nx, plane);
+
+    const bool xBoundaryThread = tx == 0 || tx == BLOCK_X - 1;
+    const bool yBoundaryThread = ty == 0 || ty == BLOCK_Y - 1;
+    const bool zBoundaryThread = tz == 0 || tz == BLOCK_Z - 1;
+
+    // Each face/edge/corner is assigned to the corresponding boundary thread.
+    // This produces fully coalesced interior loads and avoids integer divide and
+    // remainder operations in the former flattened cooperative-loading loop.
+    if (xBoundaryThread) {
+        const bool low = tx == 0;
+        const size_t haloX = low ? (originX == 0 ? 0 : originX - 1)
+                                 : min(originX + BLOCK_X, nx - 1);
+        const int haloSx = low ? 0 : BLOCK_X + 1;
+        tile[tileIndex(haloSx, sy, sz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y)] =
+            gridValue(values, haloX, y, z, nx, plane);
+
+        if (yBoundaryThread) {
+            const bool yLow = ty == 0;
+            const size_t haloY = yLow ? (originY == 0 ? 0 : originY - 1)
+                                      : min(originY + BLOCK_Y, ny - 1);
+            const int haloSy = yLow ? 0 : BLOCK_Y + 1;
+            tile[tileIndex(haloSx, haloSy, sz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y)] =
+                gridValue(values, haloX, haloY, z, nx, plane);
+
+            if (zBoundaryThread) {
+                const bool zLow = tz == 0;
+                const size_t haloZ = zLow ? (originZ == 0 ? 0 : originZ - 1)
+                                          : min(originZ + BLOCK_Z, nz - 1);
+                const int haloSz = zLow ? 0 : BLOCK_Z + 1;
+                tile[tileIndex(haloSx, haloSy, haloSz,
+                               R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y)] =
+                    gridValue(values, haloX, haloY, haloZ, nx, plane);
             }
         }
+
+        if (zBoundaryThread) {
+            const bool zLow = tz == 0;
+            const size_t haloZ = zLow ? (originZ == 0 ? 0 : originZ - 1)
+                                      : min(originZ + BLOCK_Z, nz - 1);
+            const int haloSz = zLow ? 0 : BLOCK_Z + 1;
+            tile[tileIndex(haloSx, sy, haloSz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y)] =
+                gridValue(values, haloX, y, haloZ, nx, plane);
+        }
     }

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)
+void computeChemicalPotentialKernel(double* __restrict__ mu,
+                                    const double* __restrict__ input,
+                                    const size_t nx, const size_t ny,
+                                    const size_t nz, const size_t plane) {
+    __shared__ double cTile[R1_TILE_SIZE];
+    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
+    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
+    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
+    stageRadiusOne(cTile, input, nx, ny, nz, plane);
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) return;
+
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
+    const int tz = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(tx, ty, tz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y);
+    const double center = cTile[centerIndex];
+    const double cxx = cTile[centerIndex + 1] + cTile[centerIndex - 1]
+                     - 2.0 * center;
+    const double cyy = cTile[centerIndex + R1_TILE_X]
+                     + cTile[centerIndex - R1_TILE_X] - 2.0 * center;
+    constexpr size_t r1Plane = R1_TILE_X * R1_TILE_Y;
+    const double czz = cTile[centerIndex + r1Plane]
+                     + cTile[centerIndex - r1Plane] - 2.0 * center;
+    const double bulk = center * center * center - center;
+    mu[z * plane + y * nx + x] = bulk - 0.5 * (cxx + cyy + czz);
 }

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)
+void cahnHilliardStep(double* __restrict__ output,
+                      const double* __restrict__ input,
+                      const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+                      const size_t plane) {
+    __shared__ double shared[C_TILE_SIZE + MU_TILE_SIZE];
+    double* const cTile = shared;
+    double* const muTile = shared + C_TILE_SIZE;
+
+    const int tid = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x)
+                  + BLOCK_X * (static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y)
+                  + BLOCK_Y * static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z));
+    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
+    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
+    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
+
+    // Cooperatively stage the radius-two concentration tile.  Loading a
+    // clamped halo here gives the same zero-normal-gradient boundary rule as
+    // the original per-neighbor index clamping.
+    for (int linear = tid; linear < C_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
+        const int localX = linear % C_TILE_X;
+        const int yz = linear / C_TILE_X;
+        const int localY = yz % C_TILE_Y;
+        const int localZ = yz / C_TILE_Y;
+
+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originX) + localX - 2, nx);
+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + localY - 2, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + localZ - 2, nz);
+        cTile[linear] = input[globalZ * plane + globalY * nx + globalX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    // Form mu for the output tile and its one-cell halo.  The coordinate is
+    // clamped before locating its center in cTile; this detail is required at
+    // domain faces because Laplacian(mu) reuses mu at the boundary itself.
+    for (int linear = tid; linear < MU_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
+        const int muX = linear % MU_TILE_X;
+        const int yz = linear / MU_TILE_X;
+        const int muY = yz % MU_TILE_Y;
+        const int muZ = yz / MU_TILE_Y;
+
+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originX) + muX - 1, nx);
+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + muY - 1, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + muZ - 1, nz);
+
+        const int cX = static_cast<int>(globalX - originX) + 2;
+        const int cY = static_cast<int>(globalY - originY) + 2;
+        const int cZ = static_cast<int>(globalZ - originZ) + 2;
+        muTile[linear] = chemicalPotential(cTile, cX, cY, cZ);
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int muX = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;
+    const int muY = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
+    const int muZ = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t muCenter = tileIndex(muX, muY, muZ, MU_TILE_X, MU_TILE_Y);
+    constexpr size_t muPlane = MU_TILE_X * MU_TILE_Y;
+    const double center = muTile[muCenter];
+    const double laplacianMu =
+        (muTile[muCenter + 1] + muTile[muCenter - 1] - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[muCenter + MU_TILE_X] + muTile[muCenter - MU_TILE_X]
+         - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[muCenter + muPlane] + muTile[muCenter - muPlane]
+         - 2.0 * center);
+
+    const size_t globalIndex = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    output[globalIndex] = cTile[tileIndex(muX + 1, muY + 1, muZ + 1,
+                                          C_TILE_X, C_TILE_Y)]
+                        + 0.01 * laplacianMu;
+}

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)
+void computeChemicalPotentialKernel(double* __restrict__ mu,
+                                    const double* __restrict__ input,
+                                    const size_t nx, const size_t ny,
+                                    const size_t nz, const size_t plane) {
+    __shared__ double cTile[R1_TILE_SIZE];
+    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
+    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
+    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
+    stageRadiusOne(cTile, input, nx, ny, nz, plane);
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) return;
+
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
+    const int tz = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(tx, ty, tz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y);
+    const double center = cTile[centerIndex];
+    const double cxx = cTile[centerIndex + 1] + cTile[centerIndex - 1]
+                     - 2.0 * center;
+    const double cyy = cTile[centerIndex + R1_TILE_X]
+                     + cTile[centerIndex - R1_TILE_X] - 2.0 * center;
+    constexpr size_t r1Plane = R1_TILE_X * R1_TILE_Y;
+    const double czz = cTile[centerIndex + r1Plane]
+                     + cTile[centerIndex - r1Plane] - 2.0 * center;
+    const double bulk = center * center * center - center;
+    mu[z * plane + y * nx + x] = bulk - 0.5 * (cxx + cyy + czz);

+    __shared__ double muTile[R1_TILE_SIZE];
+    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
+    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
+    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
+    stageRadiusOne(muTile, mu, nx, ny, nz, plane);
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) return;
+
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
+    const int tz = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(tx, ty, tz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y);
+    const double center = muTile[centerIndex];
+    constexpr size_t r1Plane = R1_TILE_X * R1_TILE_Y;
+    const double laplacianMu =
+        (muTile[centerIndex + 1] + muTile[centerIndex - 1] - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[centerIndex + R1_TILE_X] + muTile[centerIndex - R1_TILE_X]
+         - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[centerIndex + r1Plane] + muTile[centerIndex - r1Plane]
+         - 2.0 * center);
+    const size_t globalIndex = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    output[globalIndex] = input[globalIndex] + 0.01 * laplacianMu;
+}
+
+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)
+void cahnHilliardStep(double* __restrict__ output,
+                      const double* __restrict__ input,
+                      const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,
+                      const size_t plane) {
+    __shared__ double shared[C_TILE_SIZE + MU_TILE_SIZE];
+    double* const cTile = shared;
+    double* const muTile = shared + C_TILE_SIZE;
+
+    const int tid = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x)
+                  + BLOCK_X * (static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y)
+                  + BLOCK_Y * static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z));
+    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
+    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
+    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
+
+    // Cooperatively stage the radius-two concentration tile.  Loading a
+    // clamped halo here gives the same zero-normal-gradient boundary rule as
+    // the original per-neighbor index clamping.
+    for (int linear = tid; linear < C_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
+        const int localX = linear % C_TILE_X;
+        const int yz = linear / C_TILE_X;
+        const int localY = yz % C_TILE_Y;
+        const int localZ = yz / C_TILE_Y;
+
+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originX) + localX - 2, nx);
+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + localY - 2, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + localZ - 2, nz);
+        cTile[linear] = input[globalZ * plane + globalY * nx + globalX];
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    // Form mu for the output tile and its one-cell halo.  The coordinate is
+    // clamped before locating its center in cTile; this detail is required at
+    // domain faces because Laplacian(mu) reuses mu at the boundary itself.
+    for (int linear = tid; linear < MU_TILE_SIZE; linear += BLOCK_THREADS) {
+        const int muX = linear % MU_TILE_X;
+        const int yz = linear / MU_TILE_X;
+        const int muY = yz % MU_TILE_Y;
+        const int muZ = yz / MU_TILE_Y;
+
+        const size_t globalX = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originX) + muX - 1, nx);
+        const size_t globalY = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originY) + muY - 1, ny);
+        const size_t globalZ = clampCoordinate(
+            static_cast<long long>(originZ) + muZ - 1, nz);
+
+        const int cX = static_cast<int>(globalX - originX) + 2;
+        const int cY = static_cast<int>(globalY - originY) + 2;
+        const int cZ = static_cast<int>(globalZ - originZ) + 2;
+        muTile[linear] = chemicalPotential(cTile, cX, cY, cZ);
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) {
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const int muX = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;
+    const int muY = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
+    const int muZ = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t muCenter = tileIndex(muX, muY, muZ, MU_TILE_X, MU_TILE_Y);
+    constexpr size_t muPlane = MU_TILE_X * MU_TILE_Y;
+    const double center = muTile[muCenter];
+    const double laplacianMu =
+        (muTile[muCenter + 1] + muTile[muCenter - 1] - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[muCenter + MU_TILE_X] + muTile[muCenter - MU_TILE_X]
+         - 2.0 * center) +
+        (muTile[muCenter + muPlane] + muTile[muCenter - muPlane]
+         - 2.0 * center);
+
+    const size_t globalIndex = z * plane + y * nx + x;
+    output[globalIndex] = cTile[tileIndex(muX + 1, muY + 1, muZ + 1,
+                                          C_TILE_X, C_TILE_Y)]
+                        + 0.01 * laplacianMu;
+}
+
+void initializeConcentration(std::vector<double>& c) {
+    const size_t volume = c.size();
+    for (size_t linearId = 0; linearId < volume; ++linearId) {
+        const double pseudo = ((linearId + 1) * size_t{1299709} % volume)
+                            / static_cast<double>(volume);
+        c[linearId] = -1.0 + 2.0 * pseudo;
+    }
+}

+__device__ __forceinline__ double chemicalPotential(const double* __restrict__ c,
+                                                    const int x, const int y,
+                                                    const int z) {
+    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(x, y, z, C_TILE_X, C_TILE_Y);
+    const double center = c[centerIndex];
+    const double cxx = c[centerIndex + 1] + c[centerIndex - 1] - 2.0 * center;
+    const double cyy = c[centerIndex + C_TILE_X] + c[centerIndex - C_TILE_X]
+                     - 2.0 * center;
+    constexpr size_t cPlane = C_TILE_X * C_TILE_Y;
+    const double czz = c[centerIndex + cPlane] + c[centerIndex - cPlane]
+                     - 2.0 * center;
+
+    // With the benchmark's fixed interaction energies this is exactly the
+    // polynomial represented by the original bulk-energy expression.
+    const double bulk = center * center * center - center;
+    return bulk - 0.5 * (cxx + cyy + czz);
+}

+constexpr int R1_TILE_X = BLOCK_X + 2;
+constexpr int R1_TILE_Y = BLOCK_Y + 2;
+constexpr int R1_TILE_Z = BLOCK_Z + 2;
+constexpr int R1_TILE_SIZE = R1_TILE_X * R1_TILE_Y * R1_TILE_Z;

+__device__ __forceinline__ double gridValue(const double* __restrict__ values,
+                                            const size_t x, const size_t y,
+                                            const size_t z, const size_t nx,
+                                            const size_t plane) {
+    return values[z * plane + y * nx + x];
+}

+__device__ __forceinline__ void stageRadiusOne(double* __restrict__ tile,
+                                               const double* __restrict__ values,
+                                               const size_t nx, const size_t ny,
+                                               const size_t nz,
+                                               const size_t plane) {
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x);
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y);
+    const int tz = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z);
+    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
+    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
+    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
+    const size_t x = min(originX + static_cast<size_t>(tx), nx - 1);
+    const size_t y = min(originY + static_cast<size_t>(ty), ny - 1);
+    const size_t z = min(originZ + static_cast<size_t>(tz), nz - 1);
+    const int sx = tx + 1;
+    const int sy = ty + 1;
+    const int sz = tz + 1;
+
+    tile[tileIndex(sx, sy, sz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y)] =
+        gridValue(values, x, y, z, nx, plane);
+
+    const bool xBoundaryThread = tx == 0 || tx == BLOCK_X - 1;
+    const bool yBoundaryThread = ty == 0 || ty == BLOCK_Y - 1;
+    const bool zBoundaryThread = tz == 0 || tz == BLOCK_Z - 1;
+
+    // Each face/edge/corner is assigned to the corresponding boundary thread.
+    // This produces fully coalesced interior loads and avoids integer divide and
+    // remainder operations in the former flattened cooperative-loading loop.
+    if (xBoundaryThread) {
+        const bool low = tx == 0;
+        const size_t haloX = low ? (originX == 0 ? 0 : originX - 1)
+                                 : min(originX + BLOCK_X, nx - 1);
+        const int haloSx = low ? 0 : BLOCK_X + 1;
+        tile[tileIndex(haloSx, sy, sz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y)] =
+            gridValue(values, haloX, y, z, nx, plane);
+
+        if (yBoundaryThread) {
+            const bool yLow = ty == 0;
+            const size_t haloY = yLow ? (originY == 0 ? 0 : originY - 1)
+                                      : min(originY + BLOCK_Y, ny - 1);
+            const int haloSy = yLow ? 0 : BLOCK_Y + 1;
+            tile[tileIndex(haloSx, haloSy, sz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y)] =
+                gridValue(values, haloX, haloY, z, nx, plane);
+
+            if (zBoundaryThread) {
+                const bool zLow = tz == 0;
+                const size_t haloZ = zLow ? (originZ == 0 ? 0 : originZ - 1)
+                                          : min(originZ + BLOCK_Z, nz - 1);
+                const int haloSz = zLow ? 0 : BLOCK_Z + 1;
+                tile[tileIndex(haloSx, haloSy, haloSz,
+                               R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y)] =
+                    gridValue(values, haloX, haloY, haloZ, nx, plane);
             }
         }
+
+        if (zBoundaryThread) {
+            const bool zLow = tz == 0;
+            const size_t haloZ = zLow ? (originZ == 0 ? 0 : originZ - 1)
+                                      : min(originZ + BLOCK_Z, nz - 1);
+            const int haloSz = zLow ? 0 : BLOCK_Z + 1;
+            tile[tileIndex(haloSx, sy, haloSz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y)] =

     }

+__global__ __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)
+void computeChemicalPotentialKernel(double* __restrict__ mu,
+                                    const double* __restrict__ input,
+                                    const size_t nx, const size_t ny,
+                                    const size_t nz, const size_t plane) {

+    const size_t originX = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BLOCK_X;
+    const size_t originY = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BLOCK_Y;
+    const size_t originZ = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.z) * BLOCK_Z;
+    stageRadiusOne(cTile, input, nx, ny, nz, plane);
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    const size_t x = originX + threadIdx.x;
+    const size_t y = originY + threadIdx.y;
+    const size_t z = originZ + threadIdx.z;
+    if (x >= nx || y >= ny || z >= nz) return;
+
+    const int tx = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.x) + 1;
+    const int ty = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.y) + 1;
+    const int tz = static_cast<int>(threadIdx.z) + 1;
+    const size_t centerIndex = tileIndex(tx, ty, tz, R1_TILE_X, R1_TILE_Y);
+    const double center = cTile[centerIndex];
+    const double cxx = cTile[centerIndex + 1] + cTile[centerIndex - 1]
+                     - 2.0 * center;
+    const double cyy = cTile[centerIndex + R1_TILE_X]
+                     + cTile[centerIndex - R1_TILE_X] - 2.0 * center;
+    constexpr size_t r1Plane = R1_TILE_X * R1_TILE_Y;
+    const double czz = cTile[centerIndex + r1Plane]
+                     + cTile[centerIndex - r1Plane] - 2.0 * center;

+    mu[z * plane + y * nx + x] = bulk - 0.5 * (cxx + cyy + czz);
